+  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
+  environment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (environment IN ('LIVE','PAPER','SHADOW','BACKTEST')),
+  database_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
+  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
+);
+
+CREATE TRIGGER db_identity_no_update
+BEFORE UPDATE ON db_identity
+BEGIN
+  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'immutable: db_identity');
+END;
+
+CREATE TRIGGER db_identity_no_delete
+BEFORE DELETE ON db_identity
+BEGIN
+  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'immutable: db_identity');
+END;
+
+CREATE TABLE account_scopes (
+  account_scope_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+  environment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (environment IN ('LIVE','PAPER','SHADOW','BACKTEST')),
+  broker TEXT,
+  broker_account_ref TEXT,
+  scenario_name TEXT,
+  run_id TEXT,
+  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
+  CHECK (environment <> 'SHADOW' OR scenario_name IS NOT NULL),
+  CHECK (environment <> 'BACKTEST' OR run_id IS NOT NULL),
+  CHECK (environment NOT IN ('LIVE','PAPER') OR broker_account_ref IS NOT NULL)
+);
+
+CREATE TRIGGER account_scopes_environment_guard
+BEFORE INSERT ON account_scopes
+WHEN (SELECT environment FROM db_identity WHERE id = 1) IS NULL
+  OR NEW.environment <> (SELECT environment FROM db_identity WHERE id = 1)
+BEGIN
+  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'account scope environment differs from database identity');
+END;
+
+CREATE INDEX account_scopes_created_at_idx

+CREATE TABLE run_configs (
+  run_config_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,

+  config_json TEXT NOT NULL,

+   ``.sql`` suffix (for example, ``initial``).
+3. Database environments may be supplied as either ``AccountEnvironment``
+   values or their uppercase strings, keeping this infrastructure boundary
+   convenient without duplicating the domain enum.
+4. Decimal reads reject non-finite values just as decimal writes do, so corrupt
+   persisted numeric text cannot silently enter the domain.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import re
+import sqlite3
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Final
+from uuid import uuid4
+
+from mike_trade.domain.accounts import AccountEnvironment
+from mike_trade.domain.errors import PersistenceError
+
+__all__ = [
+    "open_connection",
+    "discover_migrations",
+    "apply_migrations",
+    "current_schema_version",
+    "initialize_database",
+    "to_db_timestamp",
+    "from_db_timestamp",
+    "decimal_to_db",
+    "decimal_from_db",
+    "EXPECTED_TABLES",
+    "MigrationChecksumError",
+    "SchemaTooNewError",
+    "DatabaseIdentityMismatchError",
+]
+
+
+class MigrationChecksumError(PersistenceError):
+    """An applied migration no longer has its recorded contents."""
+
+
+class SchemaTooNewError(PersistenceError):
+    """The database was migrated by a newer version of the application."""
+
+
+class DatabaseIdentityMismatchError(PersistenceError):
+    """The database identity does not match the requested environment."""
+
+
+EXPECTED_TABLES: Final[frozenset[str]] = frozenset(
+    {
+        "schema_migrations",
+        "db_identity",
+        "account_scopes",
+        "run_configs",
+        "operator_commands",
+        "service_health",
+        "instruments",
+        "instrument_capabilities",
+        "market_bars",
+        "strategy_instances",
+        "strategy_evaluations",
+        "signals",
+        "decisions",
+        "position_cycles",
+        "budget_reservations",
+        "order_intents",
+        "broker_orders",
+        "broker_order_events",
+        "fills",
+        "broker_activities",
+        "protection_orders",
+        "trailing_stop_states",
+        "trailing_stop_events",
+        "positions",
+        "cash_events",
+        "equity_snapshots",
+        "reconciliation_runs",
+        "reconciliation_drifts",
+        "reconciliation_resolutions",
+        "strategy_state",
+        "entry_eligibility_counters",
+        "entry_lockouts",
+        "entry_cooldowns",

+        "backtest_manifests",
+        "domain_events",
+    }
+)
+
+_MIGRATION_RE = re.compile(r"^(?P<version>[0-9]{4})_(?P<name>[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\.sql$")
+_ENVIRONMENTS = frozenset(item.value for item in AccountEnvironment)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class _Migration:
+    version: int
+    name: str
+    path: Path
+    text: str
+    sha256: str
+
+
+def open_connection(path: str | Path, *, read_only: bool = False) -> sqlite3.Connection:
+    """Open a configured SQLite connection for an operational database."""
+    database_path = Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
+    if read_only:
+        uri = f"{database_path.as_uri()}?mode=ro"
+        conn = sqlite3.connect(uri, uri=True, isolation_level=None)
+        try:
+            conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
+            conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000")
+            conn.execute("PRAGMA query_only = ON")
+        except BaseException:
+            conn.close()
+            raise
+        return conn
+
+    conn = sqlite3.connect(database_path, isolation_level=None)
+    try:
+        conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
+        mode = str(conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL").fetchone()[0]).lower()
+        if mode != "wal":
+            raise PersistenceError(f"SQLite refused WAL mode for {database_path}: {mode!r}")
+        conn.execute("PRAGMA synchronous = FULL")
+        conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000")
+    except BaseException:
+        conn.close()
+        raise
+    return conn
+
+
+def discover_migrations(migrations_dir: str | Path | None = None) -> tuple[_Migration, ...]:
+    """Read a complete, consecutively numbered set of forward migrations."""
+    directory = (
+        Path(migrations_dir)
+        if migrations_dir is not None
+        else Path(__file__).parent / "migrations"
+    )
+    discovered: list[_Migration] = []
+    versions: set[int] = set()
+    for path in sorted(directory.iterdir() if directory.is_dir() else (), key=lambda item: item.name):
+        match = _MIGRATION_RE.fullmatch(path.name)
+        if match is None or not path.is_file():
+            continue
+        version = int(match.group("version"))
+        if version in versions:
+            raise PersistenceError(f"duplicate migration version {version:04d} in {directory}")
+        versions.add(version)
+        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+        discovered.append(
+            _Migration(
+                version=version,
+                name=match.group("name"),
+                path=path,
+                text=text,
+                sha256=hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
+            )
+        )
+    discovered.sort(key=lambda migration: migration.version)
+    actual = [migration.version for migration in discovered]
+    expected = list(range(1, len(discovered) + 1))
+    if actual != expected:
+        raise PersistenceError(
+            f"migration versions must be consecutive starting at 0001; found {actual}"
+        )
+    return tuple(discovered)
+
+
+def _schema_migrations_exists(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> bool:
+    row = conn.execute(
+        "SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'schema_migrations'"
+    ).fetchone()
+    return row is not None
+
+
+def current_schema_version(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> int:
+    """Return the greatest applied migration version, or zero for a fresh DB."""
+    if not _schema_migrations_exists(conn):
+        return 0
+    row = conn.execute("SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) FROM schema_migrations").fetchone()
+    return int(row[0])
+
+
+def _migration_statements(text: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+    """Split SQL without losing trigger bodies; unlike executescript, do not commit."""
+    statements: list[str] = []
+    buffer = ""
+    for character in text:
+        buffer += character
+        if character == ";" and sqlite3.complete_statement(buffer):
+            if buffer.strip():
+                statements.append(buffer)
+            buffer = ""
+    if buffer.strip() and not all(line.lstrip().startswith("--") for line in buffer.splitlines() if line.strip()):
+        if not sqlite3.complete_statement(buffer):
+            raise sqlite3.OperationalError("incomplete SQL at end of migration")
+        statements.append(buffer)
+    return tuple(statements)
+
+
+def apply_migrations(
+    conn: sqlite3.Connection,
+    migrations_dir: str | Path | None = None,
+    *,
+    now: datetime,
+) -> None:
+    """Verify applied migration contents and atomically apply each pending file."""
+    migrations = discover_migrations(migrations_dir)
+    current = current_schema_version(conn)
+    highest_known = migrations[-1].version if migrations else 0
+    if current > highest_known:
+        raise SchemaTooNewError(
+            f"database schema version {current} exceeds highest known version {highest_known}"
+        )
+
+    applied: dict[int, tuple[str, str]] = {}
+    if _schema_migrations_exists(conn):
+        rows = conn.execute("SELECT version, name, sha256 FROM schema_migrations").fetchall()
+        applied = {int(version): (str(name), str(checksum)) for version, name, checksum in rows}
+    known_by_version = {migration.version: migration for migration in migrations}
+    unknown_applied = sorted(set(applied) - set(known_by_version))
+    if unknown_applied:
+        raise SchemaTooNewError(f"database contains unknown migration versions: {unknown_applied}")
+    for version, (_, recorded_checksum) in applied.items():
+        migration = known_by_version[version]
+        if recorded_checksum != migration.sha256:
+            raise MigrationChecksumError(
+                f"migration {version:04d}_{migration.name}.sql checksum does not match database"
+            )
+
+    applied_at = to_db_timestamp(now)
+    for migration in migrations:
+        if migration.version in applied:
+            continue
+        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+        try:
+            for statement in _migration_statements(migration.text):
+                conn.execute(statement)
+            conn.execute(
+                "INSERT INTO schema_migrations(version, name, sha256, applied_at) "
+                "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
+                (migration.version, migration.name, migration.sha256, applied_at),
+            )
+            conn.execute("COMMIT")
+        except BaseException:
+            if conn.in_transaction:
+                conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
+            raise
+
+
+def _environment_value(environment: AccountEnvironment | str) -> str:
+    value = environment.value if isinstance(environment, AccountEnvironment) else environment
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or value not in _ENVIRONMENTS:
+        raise ValueError(f"environment must be one of {sorted(_ENVIRONMENTS)}")
+    return value
+
+
+def initialize_database(
+    path: str | Path,
+    environment: AccountEnvironment | str,
+    *,
+    now: datetime,
+) -> sqlite3.Connection:
+    """Open, migrate, and bind a database permanently to one environment."""
+    expected_environment = _environment_value(environment)
+    conn = open_connection(path)
+    try:
+        apply_migrations(conn, now=now)
+        created_at = to_db_timestamp(now)
+        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+        try:
+            identity = conn.execute(
+                "SELECT environment FROM db_identity WHERE id = 1"
+            ).fetchone()
+            if identity is None:
+                conn.execute(
+                    "INSERT INTO db_identity(id, environment, database_id, created_at) "
+                    "VALUES (1, ?, ?, ?)",
+                    (expected_environment, str(uuid4()), created_at),
+                )
+            elif identity[0] != expected_environment:
+                raise DatabaseIdentityMismatchError(
+                    f"database environment is {identity[0]!r}, not {expected_environment!r}"
+                )
+            conn.execute("COMMIT")
+        except BaseException:
+            if conn.in_transaction:
+                conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
+            raise
+    except BaseException:
+        conn.close()
+        raise
+    return conn
+
+
+def to_db_timestamp(value: datetime) -> str:
+    """Serialize an aware datetime as fixed-width microsecond UTC text."""
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError("database timestamps require a timezone-aware datetime")
+    return value.astimezone(UTC).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ")
+
+
+def from_db_timestamp(text: str) -> datetime:
+    """Parse the database's fixed-width UTC timestamp representation."""
+    if not isinstance(text, str):
+        raise TypeError("database timestamp must be str")
+    try:
+        return datetime.strptime(text, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ").replace(tzinfo=UTC)
+    except ValueError as error:
+        raise ValueError(f"invalid database timestamp: {text!r}") from error
+
+
+def decimal_to_db(value: Decimal) -> str:
+    """Serialize a finite Decimal without accepting lossy float input."""
+    if not isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        raise TypeError("database decimal value must be Decimal")
+    if not value.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError("database decimal value must be finite")
+    return str(value)
+
+
+def decimal_from_db(text: str) -> Decimal:
+    """Parse finite decimal text from SQLite."""
+    if not isinstance(text, str):
+        raise TypeError("database decimal value must be str")
+    try:
+        value = Decimal(text)
+    except InvalidOperation as error:
+        raise ValueError(f"invalid database decimal: {text!r}") from error
+    if not value.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError("database decimal value must be finite")
+    return value

+    assert from_db_timestamp(STAMP) == NOW
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="timezone-aware"):
+        to_db_timestamp(datetime(2026, 10, 8))
+
+
+def test_decimal_helpers_require_finite_decimals() -> None:
+    assert decimal_to_db(Decimal("1.2300")) == "1.2300"
+    assert decimal_from_db("1.2300") == Decimal("1.2300")
+    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
+        decimal_to_db(1.23)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="finite"):
+        decimal_to_db(Decimal("NaN"))
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="finite"):
+        decimal_from_db("Infinity")

+"""SQLite connection, migration, and scalar-persistence helpers.
+
+Design choices (4, the task's decision budget):
+1. ``discover_migrations`` returns immutable private records containing the
+   version, unprefixed name, path, text, and text checksum.
+2. Migration names stored in ``schema_migrations`` omit the numeric prefix and
+   ``.sql`` suffix (for example, ``initial``).
+3. Database environments may be supplied as either ``AccountEnvironment``
+   values or their uppercase strings, keeping this infrastructure boundary
+   convenient without duplicating the domain enum.
+4. Decimal reads reject non-finite values just as decimal writes do, so corrupt
+   persisted numeric text cannot silently enter the domain.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import re
+import sqlite3
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Final
+from uuid import uuid4
+
+from mike_trade.domain.accounts import AccountEnvironment
+from mike_trade.domain.errors import PersistenceError
+
+__all__ = [
+    "open_connection",
+    "discover_migrations",
+    "apply_migrations",
+    "current_schema_version",
+    "initialize_database",
+    "to_db_timestamp",
+    "from_db_timestamp",
+    "decimal_to_db",
+    "decimal_from_db",
+    "EXPECTED_TABLES",
+    "MigrationChecksumError",
+    "SchemaTooNewError",
+    "DatabaseIdentityMismatchError",
+]
+
+
+class MigrationChecksumError(PersistenceError):
+    """An applied migration no longer has its recorded contents."""
+
+
+class SchemaTooNewError(PersistenceError):
+    """The database was migrated by a newer version of the application."""
+
+
+class DatabaseIdentityMismatchError(PersistenceError):
+    """The database identity does not match the requested environment."""
+
+
+EXPECTED_TABLES: Final[frozenset[str]] = frozenset(
+    {
+        "schema_migrations",
+        "db_identity",
+        "account_scopes",
+        "run_configs",
+        "operator_commands",
+        "service_health",
+        "instruments",
+        "instrument_capabilities",
+        "market_bars",
+        "strategy_instances",
+        "strategy_evaluations",
+        "signals",
+        "decisions",
+        "position_cycles",
+        "budget_reservations",
+        "order_intents",
+        "broker_orders",
+        "broker_order_events",
+        "fills",
+        "broker_activities",
+        "protection_orders",
+        "trailing_stop_states",
+        "trailing_stop_events",
+        "positions",
+        "cash_events",
+        "equity_snapshots",
+        "reconciliation_runs",
+        "reconciliation_drifts",
+        "reconciliation_resolutions",
+        "strategy_state",
+        "entry_eligibility_counters",
+        "entry_lockouts",
+        "entry_cooldowns",
+        "entry_controls",
+        "backtest_manifests",
+        "domain_events",
+    }
+)
+
+_MIGRATION_RE = re.compile(r"^(?P<version>[0-9]{4})_(?P<name>[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\.sql$")
+_ENVIRONMENTS = frozenset(item.value for item in AccountEnvironment)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class _Migration:
+    version: int
+    name: str
+    path: Path
+    text: str
+    sha256: str
+
+
+def open_connection(path: str | Path, *, read_only: bool = False) -> sqlite3.Connection:
+    """Open a configured SQLite connection for an operational database."""
+    database_path = Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
+    if read_only:
+        uri = f"{database_path.as_uri()}?mode=ro"
+        conn = sqlite3.connect(uri, uri=True, isolation_level=None)
+        try:
+            conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
+            conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000")
+            conn.execute("PRAGMA query_only = ON")
+        except BaseException:
+            conn.close()
+            raise
+        return conn
+
+    conn = sqlite3.connect(database_path, isolation_level=None)
+    try:
+        conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
+        mode = str(conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL").fetchone()[0]).lower()
+        if mode != "wal":
+            raise PersistenceError(f"SQLite refused WAL mode for {database_path}: {mode!r}")
+        conn.execute("PRAGMA synchronous = FULL")
+        conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000")
+    except BaseException:
+        conn.close()
+        raise
+    return conn
+
+
+def discover_migrations(migrations_dir: str | Path | None = None) -> tuple[_Migration, ...]:
+    """Read a complete, consecutively numbered set of forward migrations."""
+    directory = (
+        Path(migrations_dir)
+        if migrations_dir is not None
+        else Path(__file__).parent / "migrations"
+    )
+    discovered: list[_Migration] = []
+    versions: set[int] = set()
+    for path in sorted(directory.iterdir() if directory.is_dir() else (), key=lambda item: item.name):
+        match = _MIGRATION_RE.fullmatch(path.name)
+        if match is None or not path.is_file():
+            continue
+        version = int(match.group("version"))
+        if version in versions:
+            raise PersistenceError(f"duplicate migration version {version:04d} in {directory}")
+        versions.add(version)
+        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+        discovered.append(
+            _Migration(
+                version=version,
+                name=match.group("name"),
+                path=path,
+                text=text,
+                sha256=hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
+            )
+        )
+    discovered.sort(key=lambda migration: migration.version)
+    actual = [migration.version for migration in discovered]
+    expected = list(range(1, len(discovered) + 1))
+    if actual != expected:
+        raise PersistenceError(
+            f"migration versions must be consecutive starting at 0001; found {actual}"
+        )
+    return tuple(discovered)
+
+
+def _schema_migrations_exists(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> bool:
+    row = conn.execute(
+        "SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'schema_migrations'"
+    ).fetchone()
+    return row is not None
+
+
+def current_schema_version(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> int:
+    """Return the greatest applied migration version, or zero for a fresh DB."""
+    if not _schema_migrations_exists(conn):
+        return 0
+    row = conn.execute("SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) FROM schema_migrations").fetchone()
+    return int(row[0])
+
+
+def _migration_statements(text: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+    """Split SQL without losing trigger bodies; unlike executescript, do not commit."""
+    statements: list[str] = []
+    buffer = ""
+    for character in text:
+        buffer += character
+        if character == ";" and sqlite3.complete_statement(buffer):
+            if buffer.strip():
+                statements.append(buffer)
+            buffer = ""
+    if buffer.strip() and not all(line.lstrip().startswith("--") for line in buffer.splitlines() if line.strip()):
+        if not sqlite3.complete_statement(buffer):
+            raise sqlite3.OperationalError("incomplete SQL at end of migration")
+        statements.append(buffer)
+    return tuple(statements)
+
+
+def apply_migrations(
+    conn: sqlite3.Connection,
+    migrations_dir: str | Path | None = None,
+    *,
+    now: datetime,
+) -> None:
+    """Verify applied migration contents and atomically apply each pending file."""
+    migrations = discover_migrations(migrations_dir)
+    current = current_schema_version(conn)
+    highest_known = migrations[-1].version if migrations else 0
+    if current > highest_known:
+        raise SchemaTooNewError(
+            f"database schema version {current} exceeds highest known version {highest_known}"
+        )
+
+    applied: dict[int, tuple[str, str]] = {}
+    if _schema_migrations_exists(conn):
+        rows = conn.execute("SELECT version, name, sha256 FROM schema_migrations").fetchall()
+        applied = {int(version): (str(name), str(checksum)) for version, name, checksum in rows}
+    known_by_version = {migration.version: migration for migration in migrations}
+    unknown_applied = sorted(set(applied) - set(known_by_version))
+    if unknown_applied:
+        raise SchemaTooNewError(f"database contains unknown migration versions: {unknown_applied}")
+    for version, (_, recorded_checksum) in applied.items():
+        migration = known_by_version[version]
+        if recorded_checksum != migration.sha256:
+            raise MigrationChecksumError(
+                f"migration {version:04d}_{migration.name}.sql checksum does not match database"
+            )
+
+    applied_at = to_db_timestamp(now)
+    for migration in migrations:
+        if migration.version in applied:
+            continue
+        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+        try:
+            for statement in _migration_statements(migration.text):
+                conn.execute(statement)
+            conn.execute(
+                "INSERT INTO schema_migrations(version, name, sha256, applied_at) "
+                "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
+                (migration.version, migration.name, migration.sha256, applied_at),
+            )
+            conn.execute("COMMIT")
+        except BaseException:
+            if conn.in_transaction:
+                conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
+            raise
+
+
+def _environment_value(environment: AccountEnvironment | str) -> str:
+    value = environment.value if isinstance(environment, AccountEnvironment) else environment
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or value not in _ENVIRONMENTS:
+        raise ValueError(f"environment must be one of {sorted(_ENVIRONMENTS)}")
+    return value
+
+
+def initialize_database(
+    path: str | Path,
+    environment: AccountEnvironment | str,
+    *,
+    now: datetime,
+) -> sqlite3.Connection:
+    """Open, migrate, and bind a database permanently to one environment."""
+    expected_environment = _environment_value(environment)
+    conn = open_connection(path)
+    try:
+        apply_migrations(conn, now=now)
+        created_at = to_db_timestamp(now)
+        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+        try:
+            identity = conn.execute(
+                "SELECT environment FROM db_identity WHERE id = 1"
+            ).fetchone()
+            if identity is None:
+                conn.execute(
+                    "INSERT INTO db_identity(id, environment, database_id, created_at) "
+                    "VALUES (1, ?, ?, ?)",
+                    (expected_environment, str(uuid4()), created_at),
+                )
+            elif identity[0] != expected_environment:
+                raise DatabaseIdentityMismatchError(
+                    f"database environment is {identity[0]!r}, not {expected_environment!r}"
+                )
+            conn.execute("COMMIT")
+        except BaseException:
+            if conn.in_transaction:
+                conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
+            raise
+    except BaseException:
+        conn.close()
+        raise
+    return conn
+
+
+def to_db_timestamp(value: datetime) -> str:
+    """Serialize an aware datetime as fixed-width microsecond UTC text."""
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError("database timestamps require a timezone-aware datetime")
+    return value.astimezone(UTC).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ")
+
+
+def from_db_timestamp(text: str) -> datetime:
+    """Parse the database's fixed-width UTC timestamp representation."""
+    if not isinstance(text, str):
+        raise TypeError("database timestamp must be str")
+    try:
+        return datetime.strptime(text, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ").replace(tzinfo=UTC)
+    except ValueError as error:
+        raise ValueError(f"invalid database timestamp: {text!r}") from error
+
+
+def decimal_to_db(value: Decimal) -> str:
+    """Serialize a finite Decimal without accepting lossy float input."""
+    if not isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        raise TypeError("database decimal value must be Decimal")
+    if not value.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError("database decimal value must be finite")
+    return str(value)
+
+
+def decimal_from_db(text: str) -> Decimal:
+    """Parse finite decimal text from SQLite."""
+    if not isinstance(text, str):
+        raise TypeError("database decimal value must be str")
+    try:
+        value = Decimal(text)
+    except InvalidOperation as error:
+        raise ValueError(f"invalid database decimal: {text!r}") from error
+    if not value.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError("database decimal value must be finite")
+    return value

+@pytest.fixture

+
+def test_fresh_apply_configures_connection_and_creates_expected_tables(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    conn = initialize_database(tmp_path / "fresh.db", "PAPER", now=NOW)
+    try:

+        assert conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode").fetchone()[0].lower() == "wal"
+        assert conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys").fetchone()[0] == 1
+        assert conn.execute("PRAGMA synchronous").fetchone()[0] == 2
+        tables = {
+            row[0]
+            for row in conn.execute(
+                "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'"
+            )
+        }
+        assert EXPECTED_TABLES <= tables

+def test_read_only_connection_rejects_writes(tmp_path: Path) -> None:

+"""SQLite connection, migration, and scalar-persistence helpers.
+
+Design choices (4, the task's decision budget):
+1. ``discover_migrations`` returns immutable private records containing the
+   version, unprefixed name, path, text, and text checksum.
+2. Migration names stored in ``schema_migrations`` omit the numeric prefix and
+   ``.sql`` suffix (for example, ``initial``).
+3. Database environments may be supplied as either ``AccountEnvironment``
+   values or their uppercase strings, keeping this infrastructure boundary
+   convenient without duplicating the domain enum.
+4. Decimal reads reject non-finite values just as decimal writes do, so corrupt
+   persisted numeric text cannot silently enter the domain.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import re
+import sqlite3
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Final
+from uuid import uuid4
+
+from mike_trade.domain.accounts import AccountEnvironment
+from mike_trade.domain.errors import PersistenceError
+
+__all__ = [
+    "open_connection",
+    "discover_migrations",
+    "apply_migrations",
+    "current_schema_version",
+    "initialize_database",
+    "to_db_timestamp",
+    "from_db_timestamp",
+    "decimal_to_db",
+    "decimal_from_db",
+    "EXPECTED_TABLES",
+    "MigrationChecksumError",
+    "SchemaTooNewError",
+    "DatabaseIdentityMismatchError",
+]
+
+
+class MigrationChecksumError(PersistenceError):
+    """An applied migration no longer has its recorded contents."""
+
+
+class SchemaTooNewError(PersistenceError):
+    """The database was migrated by a newer version of the application."""
+
+
+class DatabaseIdentityMismatchError(PersistenceError):
+    """The database identity does not match the requested environment."""
+
+
+EXPECTED_TABLES: Final[frozenset[str]] = frozenset(
+    {
+        "schema_migrations",
+        "db_identity",
+        "account_scopes",
+        "run_configs",
+        "operator_commands",
+        "service_health",
+        "instruments",
+        "instrument_capabilities",
+        "market_bars",
+        "strategy_instances",
+        "strategy_evaluations",
+        "signals",
+        "decisions",
+        "position_cycles",
+        "budget_reservations",
+        "order_intents",
+        "broker_orders",
+        "broker_order_events",
+        "fills",
+        "broker_activities",
+        "protection_orders",
+        "trailing_stop_states",
+        "trailing_stop_events",
+        "positions",
+        "cash_events",
+        "equity_snapshots",
+        "reconciliation_runs",
+        "reconciliation_drifts",
+        "reconciliation_resolutions",
+        "strategy_state",
+        "entry_eligibility_counters",
+        "entry_lockouts",
+        "entry_cooldowns",
+        "entry_controls",
+        "backtest_manifests",
+        "domain_events",
+    }
+)
+
+_MIGRATION_RE = re.compile(r"^(?P<version>[0-9]{4})_(?P<name>[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\.sql$")
+_ENVIRONMENTS = frozenset(item.value for item in AccountEnvironment)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class _Migration:
+    version: int
+    name: str
+    path: Path
+    text: str
+    sha256: str
+
+
+def open_connection(path: str | Path, *, read_only: bool = False) -> sqlite3.Connection:
+    """Open a configured SQLite connection for an operational database."""
+    database_path = Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
+    if read_only:
+        uri = f"{database_path.as_uri()}?mode=ro"
+        conn = sqlite3.connect(uri, uri=True, isolation_level=None)
+        try:
+            conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
+            conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000")
+            conn.execute("PRAGMA query_only = ON")
+        except BaseException:
+            conn.close()
+            raise
+        return conn
+
+    conn = sqlite3.connect(database_path, isolation_level=None)
+    try:
+        conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
+        mode = str(conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL").fetchone()[0]).lower()
+        if mode != "wal":
+            raise PersistenceError(f"SQLite refused WAL mode for {database_path}: {mode!r}")
+        conn.execute("PRAGMA synchronous = FULL")
+        conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000")
+    except BaseException:
+        conn.close()
+        raise
+    return conn
+
+
+def discover_migrations(migrations_dir: str | Path | None = None) -> tuple[_Migration, ...]:
+    """Read a complete, consecutively numbered set of forward migrations."""
+    directory = (
+        Path(migrations_dir)
+        if migrations_dir is not None
+        else Path(__file__).parent / "migrations"
+    )
+    discovered: list[_Migration] = []
+    versions: set[int] = set()
+    for path in sorted(directory.iterdir() if directory.is_dir() else (), key=lambda item: item.name):
+        match = _MIGRATION_RE.fullmatch(path.name)
+        if match is None or not path.is_file():
+            continue
+        version = int(match.group("version"))
+        if version in versions:
+            raise PersistenceError(f"duplicate migration version {version:04d} in {directory}")
+        versions.add(version)
+        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+        discovered.append(
+            _Migration(
+                version=version,
+                name=match.group("name"),
+                path=path,
+                text=text,
+                sha256=hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
+            )
+        )
+    discovered.sort(key=lambda migration: migration.version)
+    actual = [migration.version for migration in discovered]
+    expected = list(range(1, len(discovered) + 1))
+    if actual != expected:
+        raise PersistenceError(
+            f"migration versions must be consecutive starting at 0001; found {actual}"
+        )
+    return tuple(discovered)
+
+
+def _schema_migrations_exists(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> bool:
+    row = conn.execute(
+        "SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'schema_migrations'"
+    ).fetchone()
+    return row is not None
+
+
+def current_schema_version(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> int:
+    """Return the greatest applied migration version, or zero for a fresh DB."""
+    if not _schema_migrations_exists(conn):
+        return 0
+    row = conn.execute("SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) FROM schema_migrations").fetchone()
+    return int(row[0])
+
+
+def _migration_statements(text: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+    """Split SQL without losing trigger bodies; unlike executescript, do not commit."""
+    statements: list[str] = []
+    buffer = ""
+    for character in text:
+        buffer += character
+        if character == ";" and sqlite3.complete_statement(buffer):
+            if buffer.strip():
+                statements.append(buffer)
+            buffer = ""
+    if buffer.strip() and not all(line.lstrip().startswith("--") for line in buffer.splitlines() if line.strip()):
+        if not sqlite3.complete_statement(buffer):
+            raise sqlite3.OperationalError("incomplete SQL at end of migration")
+        statements.append(buffer)
+    return tuple(statements)
+
+
+def apply_migrations(
+    conn: sqlite3.Connection,
+    migrations_dir: str | Path | None = None,
+    *,
+    now: datetime,
+) -> None:
+    """Verify applied migration contents and atomically apply each pending file."""
+    migrations = discover_migrations(migrations_dir)
+    current = current_schema_version(conn)
+    highest_known = migrations[-1].version if migrations else 0
+    if current > highest_known:
+        raise SchemaTooNewError(
+            f"database schema version {current} exceeds highest known version {highest_known}"
+        )
+
+    applied: dict[int, tuple[str, str]] = {}
+    if _schema_migrations_exists(conn):
+        rows = conn.execute("SELECT version, name, sha256 FROM schema_migrations").fetchall()
+        applied = {int(version): (str(name), str(checksum)) for version, name, checksum in rows}
+    known_by_version = {migration.version: migration for migration in migrations}
+    unknown_applied = sorted(set(applied) - set(known_by_version))
+    if unknown_applied:
+        raise SchemaTooNewError(f"database contains unknown migration versions: {unknown_applied}")
+    for version, (_, recorded_checksum) in applied.items():
+        migration = known_by_version[version]
+        if recorded_checksum != migration.sha256:
+            raise MigrationChecksumError(
+                f"migration {version:04d}_{migration.name}.sql checksum does not match database"
+            )
+
+    applied_at = to_db_timestamp(now)
+    for migration in migrations:
+        if migration.version in applied:
+            continue
+        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+        try:
+            for statement in _migration_statements(migration.text):
+                conn.execute(statement)
+            conn.execute(
+                "INSERT INTO schema_migrations(version, name, sha256, applied_at) "
+                "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
+                (migration.version, migration.name, migration.sha256, applied_at),
+            )
+            conn.execute("COMMIT")
+        except BaseException:
+            if conn.in_transaction:
+                conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
+            raise
+
+
+def _environment_value(environment: AccountEnvironment | str) -> str:
+    value = environment.value if isinstance(environment, AccountEnvironment) else environment
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or value not in _ENVIRONMENTS:
+        raise ValueError(f"environment must be one of {sorted(_ENVIRONMENTS)}")
+    return value
+
+
+def initialize_database(
+    path: str | Path,
+    environment: AccountEnvironment | str,
+    *,
+    now: datetime,
+) -> sqlite3.Connection:
+    """Open, migrate, and bind a database permanently to one environment."""
+    expected_environment = _environment_value(environment)
+    conn = open_connection(path)
+    try:
+        apply_migrations(conn, now=now)
+        created_at = to_db_timestamp(now)
+        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+        try:
+            identity = conn.execute(
+                "SELECT environment FROM db_identity WHERE id = 1"
+            ).fetchone()
+            if identity is None:
+                conn.execute(
+                    "INSERT INTO db_identity(id, environment, database_id, created_at) "
+                    "VALUES (1, ?, ?, ?)",
+                    (expected_environment, str(uuid4()), created_at),
+                )
+            elif identity[0] != expected_environment:
+                raise DatabaseIdentityMismatchError(
+                    f"database environment is {identity[0]!r}, not {expected_environment!r}"
+                )
+            conn.execute("COMMIT")
+        except BaseException:
+            if conn.in_transaction:
+                conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
+            raise
+    except BaseException:
+        conn.close()
+        raise
+    return conn
+
+
+def to_db_timestamp(value: datetime) -> str:
+    """Serialize an aware datetime as fixed-width microsecond UTC text."""
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError("database timestamps require a timezone-aware datetime")
+    return value.astimezone(UTC).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ")
+
+
+def from_db_timestamp(text: str) -> datetime:
+    """Parse the database's fixed-width UTC timestamp representation."""
+    if not isinstance(text, str):
+        raise TypeError("database timestamp must be str")
+    try:
+        return datetime.strptime(text, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ").replace(tzinfo=UTC)
+    except ValueError as error:
+        raise ValueError(f"invalid database timestamp: {text!r}") from error
+
+
+def decimal_to_db(value: Decimal) -> str:
+    """Serialize a finite Decimal without accepting lossy float input."""
+    if not isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        raise TypeError("database decimal value must be Decimal")
+    if not value.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError("database decimal value must be finite")
+    return str(value)
+
+
+def decimal_from_db(text: str) -> Decimal:
+    """Parse finite decimal text from SQLite."""
+    if not isinstance(text, str):
+        raise TypeError("database decimal value must be str")
+    try:
+        value = Decimal(text)
+    except InvalidOperation as error:
+        raise ValueError(f"invalid database decimal: {text!r}") from error
+    if not value.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError("database decimal value must be finite")
+    return value

+CREATE TABLE schema_migrations (
+  version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,

+  sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
+  applied_at TEXT NOT NULL
+);

+CREATE TABLE db_identity (
+  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
+  environment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (environment IN ('LIVE','PAPER','SHADOW','BACKTEST')),
+  database_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
+  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
+);
+
+CREATE TRIGGER db_identity_no_update
+BEFORE UPDATE ON db_identity
+BEGIN
+  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'immutable: db_identity');
+END;
+
+CREATE TRIGGER db_identity_no_delete
+BEFORE DELETE ON db_identity
+BEGIN
+  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'immutable: db_identity');
+END;
+
+CREATE TABLE account_scopes (
+  account_scope_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+  environment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (environment IN ('LIVE','PAPER','SHADOW','BACKTEST')),
+  broker TEXT,
+  broker_account_ref TEXT,
+  scenario_name TEXT,
+  run_id TEXT,
+  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
+  CHECK (environment <> 'SHADOW' OR scenario_name IS NOT NULL),
+  CHECK (environment <> 'BACKTEST' OR run_id IS NOT NULL),
+  CHECK (environment NOT IN ('LIVE','PAPER') OR broker_account_ref IS NOT NULL)
+);
+
+CREATE TRIGGER account_scopes_environment_guard
+BEFORE INSERT ON account_scopes
+WHEN (SELECT environment FROM db_identity WHERE id = 1) IS NULL
+  OR NEW.environment <> (SELECT environment FROM db_identity WHERE id = 1)
+BEGIN
+  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'account scope environment differs from database identity');
+END;

+  config_json TEXT NOT NULL,

+CREATE TABLE strategy_evaluations (

+  client_order_id TEXT NOT NULL,

+  trail_price TEXT CHECK (trail_price IS NULL OR typeof(trail_price) = 'text'),

+CREATE TABLE broker_orders (

+CREATE TABLE broker_order_events (

+CREATE INDEX broker_order_events_recorded_at_idx

+CREATE TABLE fills (

+CREATE INDEX broker_activities_recorded_at_idx
+ON broker_activities(account_scope_id, recorded_at);

+CREATE TABLE protection_orders (

+"""SQLite connection, migration, and scalar-persistence helpers.
+
+Design choices (4, the task's decision budget):
+1. ``discover_migrations`` returns immutable private records containing the
+   version, unprefixed name, path, text, and text checksum.
+2. Migration names stored in ``schema_migrations`` omit the numeric prefix and
+   ``.sql`` suffix (for example, ``initial``).
+3. Database environments may be supplied as either ``AccountEnvironment``
+   values or their uppercase strings, keeping this infrastructure boundary
+   convenient without duplicating the domain enum.
+4. Decimal reads reject non-finite values just as decimal writes do, so corrupt
+   persisted numeric text cannot silently enter the domain.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import re
+import sqlite3
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Final
+from uuid import uuid4
+
+from mike_trade.domain.accounts import AccountEnvironment
+from mike_trade.domain.errors import PersistenceError
+
+__all__ = [
+    "open_connection",
+    "discover_migrations",
+    "apply_migrations",
+    "current_schema_version",
+    "initialize_database",
+    "to_db_timestamp",
+    "from_db_timestamp",
+    "decimal_to_db",
+    "decimal_from_db",
+    "EXPECTED_TABLES",
+    "MigrationChecksumError",
+    "SchemaTooNewError",
+    "DatabaseIdentityMismatchError",
+]
+
+
+class MigrationChecksumError(PersistenceError):
+    """An applied migration no longer has its recorded contents."""
+
+
+class SchemaTooNewError(PersistenceError):
+    """The database was migrated by a newer version of the application."""
+
+
+class DatabaseIdentityMismatchError(PersistenceError):
+    """The database identity does not match the requested environment."""
+
+
+EXPECTED_TABLES: Final[frozenset[str]] = frozenset(
+    {
+        "schema_migrations",
+        "db_identity",
+        "account_scopes",
+        "run_configs",
+        "operator_commands",
+        "service_health",
+        "instruments",
+        "instrument_capabilities",
+        "market_bars",
+        "strategy_instances",
+        "strategy_evaluations",
+        "signals",
+        "decisions",
+        "position_cycles",
+        "budget_reservations",
+        "order_intents",
+        "broker_orders",
+        "broker_order_events",
+        "fills",
+        "broker_activities",
+        "protection_orders",
+        "trailing_stop_states",
+        "trailing_stop_events",
+        "positions",
+        "cash_events",
+        "equity_snapshots",
+        "reconciliation_runs",
+        "reconciliation_drifts",
+        "reconciliation_resolutions",
+        "strategy_state",
+        "entry_eligibility_counters",
+        "entry_lockouts",
+        "entry_cooldowns",
+        "entry_controls",
+        "backtest_manifests",
+        "domain_events",
+    }
+)
+
+_MIGRATION_RE = re.compile(r"^(?P<version>[0-9]{4})_(?P<name>[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\.sql$")
+_ENVIRONMENTS = frozenset(item.value for item in AccountEnvironment)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class _Migration:
+    version: int
+    name: str
+    path: Path
+    text: str
+    sha256: str
+
+
+def open_connection(path: str | Path, *, read_only: bool = False) -> sqlite3.Connection:
+    """Open a configured SQLite connection for an operational database."""
+    database_path = Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
+    if read_only:
+        uri = f"{database_path.as_uri()}?mode=ro"
+        conn = sqlite3.connect(uri, uri=True, isolation_level=None)
+        try:
+            conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
+            conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000")
+            conn.execute("PRAGMA query_only = ON")
+        except BaseException:
+            conn.close()
+            raise
+        return conn
+
+    conn = sqlite3.connect(database_path, isolation_level=None)
+    try:
+        conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
+        mode = str(conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL").fetchone()[0]).lower()
+        if mode != "wal":
+            raise PersistenceError(f"SQLite refused WAL mode for {database_path}: {mode!r}")
+        conn.execute("PRAGMA synchronous = FULL")
+        conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000")
+    except BaseException:
+        conn.close()
+        raise
+    return conn
+
+
+def discover_migrations(migrations_dir: str | Path | None = None) -> tuple[_Migration, ...]:
+    """Read a complete, consecutively numbered set of forward migrations."""
+    directory = (
+        Path(migrations_dir)
+        if migrations_dir is not None
+        else Path(__file__).parent / "migrations"
+    )
+    discovered: list[_Migration] = []
+    versions: set[int] = set()
+    paths = directory.iterdir() if directory.is_dir() else ()
+    for path in sorted(paths, key=lambda item: item.name):
+        match = _MIGRATION_RE.fullmatch(path.name)
+        if match is None or not path.is_file():
+            continue
+        version = int(match.group("version"))
+        if version in versions:
+            raise PersistenceError(f"duplicate migration version {version:04d} in {directory}")
+        versions.add(version)
+        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+        discovered.append(
+            _Migration(
+                version=version,
+                name=match.group("name"),
+                path=path,
+                text=text,
+                sha256=hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
+            )
+        )
+    discovered.sort(key=lambda migration: migration.version)
+    actual = [migration.version for migration in discovered]
+    expected = list(range(1, len(discovered) + 1))
+    if actual != expected:
+        raise PersistenceError(
+            f"migration versions must be consecutive starting at 0001; found {actual}"
+        )
+    return tuple(discovered)
+
+
+def _schema_migrations_exists(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> bool:
+    row = conn.execute(
+        "SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'schema_migrations'"
+    ).fetchone()
+    return row is not None
+
+
+def current_schema_version(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> int:
+    """Return the greatest applied migration version, or zero for a fresh DB."""
+    if not _schema_migrations_exists(conn):
+        return 0
+    row = conn.execute("SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) FROM schema_migrations").fetchone()
+    return int(row[0])
+
+
+def _migration_statements(text: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+    """Split SQL without losing trigger bodies; unlike executescript, do not commit."""
+    statements: list[str] = []
+    buffer = ""
+    for character in text:
+        buffer += character
+        if character == ";" and sqlite3.complete_statement(buffer):
+            if buffer.strip():
+                statements.append(buffer)
+            buffer = ""
+    remaining_lines = (line for line in buffer.splitlines() if line.strip())
+    if buffer.strip() and not all(line.lstrip().startswith("--") for line in remaining_lines):
+        if not sqlite3.complete_statement(buffer):
+            raise sqlite3.OperationalError("incomplete SQL at end of migration")
+        statements.append(buffer)
+    return tuple(statements)
+
+
+def apply_migrations(
+    conn: sqlite3.Connection,
+    migrations_dir: str | Path | None = None,
+    *,
+    now: datetime,
+) -> None:
+    """Verify applied migration contents and atomically apply each pending file."""
+    migrations = discover_migrations(migrations_dir)
+    current = current_schema_version(conn)
+    highest_known = migrations[-1].version if migrations else 0
+    if current > highest_known:
+        raise SchemaTooNewError(
+            f"database schema version {current} exceeds highest known version {highest_known}"
+        )
+
+    applied: dict[int, tuple[str, str]] = {}
+    if _schema_migrations_exists(conn):
+        rows = conn.execute("SELECT version, name, sha256 FROM schema_migrations").fetchall()
+        applied = {int(version): (str(name), str(checksum)) for version, name, checksum in rows}
+    known_by_version = {migration.version: migration for migration in migrations}
+    unknown_applied = sorted(set(applied) - set(known_by_version))
+    if unknown_applied:
+        raise SchemaTooNewError(f"database contains unknown migration versions: {unknown_applied}")
+    for version, (_, recorded_checksum) in applied.items():
+        migration = known_by_version[version]
+        if recorded_checksum != migration.sha256:
+            raise MigrationChecksumError(
+                f"migration {version:04d}_{migration.name}.sql checksum does not match database"
+            )
+
+    applied_at = to_db_timestamp(now)
+    for migration in migrations:
+        if migration.version in applied:
+            continue
+        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+        try:
+            for statement in _migration_statements(migration.text):
+                conn.execute(statement)
+            conn.execute(
+                "INSERT INTO schema_migrations(version, name, sha256, applied_at) "
+                "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
+                (migration.version, migration.name, migration.sha256, applied_at),
+            )
+            conn.execute("COMMIT")
+        except BaseException:
+            if conn.in_transaction:
+                conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
+            raise
+
+
+def _environment_value(environment: AccountEnvironment | str) -> str:
+    value = environment.value if isinstance(environment, AccountEnvironment) else environment
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or value not in _ENVIRONMENTS:
+        raise ValueError(f"environment must be one of {sorted(_ENVIRONMENTS)}")
+    return value
+
+
+def initialize_database(
+    path: str | Path,
+    environment: AccountEnvironment | str,
+    *,
+    now: datetime,
+) -> sqlite3.Connection:
+    """Open, migrate, and bind a database permanently to one environment."""
+    expected_environment = _environment_value(environment)
+    conn = open_connection(path)
+    try:
+        apply_migrations(conn, now=now)
+        created_at = to_db_timestamp(now)
+        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+        try:
+            identity = conn.execute(
+                "SELECT environment FROM db_identity WHERE id = 1"
+            ).fetchone()
+            if identity is None:
+                conn.execute(
+                    "INSERT INTO db_identity(id, environment, database_id, created_at) "
+                    "VALUES (1, ?, ?, ?)",
+                    (expected_environment, str(uuid4()), created_at),
+                )
+            elif identity[0] != expected_environment:
+                raise DatabaseIdentityMismatchError(
+                    f"database environment is {identity[0]!r}, not {expected_environment!r}"
+                )
+            conn.execute("COMMIT")
+        except BaseException:
+            if conn.in_transaction:
+                conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
+            raise
+    except BaseException:
+        conn.close()
+        raise
+    return conn
+
+
+def to_db_timestamp(value: datetime) -> str:
+    """Serialize an aware datetime as fixed-width microsecond UTC text."""
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError("database timestamps require a timezone-aware datetime")
+    return value.astimezone(UTC).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ")
+
+
+def from_db_timestamp(text: str) -> datetime:
+    """Parse the database's fixed-width UTC timestamp representation."""
+    if not isinstance(text, str):
+        raise TypeError("database timestamp must be str")
+    try:
+        return datetime.strptime(text, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ").replace(tzinfo=UTC)
+    except ValueError as error:
+        raise ValueError(f"invalid database timestamp: {text!r}") from error
+
+
+def decimal_to_db(value: Decimal) -> str:
+    """Serialize a finite Decimal without accepting lossy float input."""
+    if not isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        raise TypeError("database decimal value must be Decimal")
+    if not value.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError("database decimal value must be finite")
+    return str(value)
+
+
+def decimal_from_db(text: str) -> Decimal:
+    """Parse finite decimal text from SQLite."""
+    if not isinstance(text, str):
+        raise TypeError("database decimal value must be str")
+    try:
+        value = Decimal(text)
+    except InvalidOperation as error:
+        raise ValueError(f"invalid database decimal: {text!r}") from error
+    if not value.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError("database decimal value must be finite")
+    return value

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import shutil
+import sqlite3
+from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta, timezone
+from decimal import Decimal
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+
+from mike_trade.persistence.schema import (
+    EXPECTED_TABLES,
+    DatabaseIdentityMismatchError,
+    MigrationChecksumError,
+    SchemaTooNewError,
+    apply_migrations,
+    current_schema_version,
+    decimal_from_db,
+    decimal_to_db,
+    discover_migrations,
+    from_db_timestamp,
+    initialize_database,
+    open_connection,
+    to_db_timestamp,
+)
+
+
+NOW = datetime(2026, 10, 8, 14, 30, 1, 123456, tzinfo=UTC)
+STAMP = "2026-10-08T14:30:01.123456Z"
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def connection(tmp_path: Path) -> sqlite3.Connection:
+    conn = initialize_database(tmp_path / "schema.db", "SHADOW", now=NOW)
+    yield conn
+    conn.close()
+
+
+def _scope(conn: sqlite3.Connection, scope_id: str) -> None:
+    conn.execute(
+        "INSERT INTO account_scopes("
+        "account_scope_id, environment, broker, scenario_name, created_at"
+        ") VALUES (?, 'SHADOW', 'simulated', ?, ?)",
+        (scope_id, scope_id, STAMP),
+    )
+
+
+def _broker_order(conn: sqlite3.Connection, scope_id: str, order_id: str) -> None:
+    conn.execute(
+        "INSERT INTO broker_orders("
+        "account_scope_id, broker_order_id, client_order_id, symbol, side, order_type, "
+        "status, quantity, filled_quantity, submitted_at, updated_at"
+        ") VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'AAPL', 'BUY', 'MARKET', 'FILLED', '1', '1', ?, ?)",
+        (scope_id, order_id, f"client-{order_id}", STAMP, STAMP),
+    )
+
+
+def _fill(
+    conn: sqlite3.Connection,
+    scope_id: str,
+    fill_id: str,
+    activity_id: str,
+    order_id: str,
+    *,
+    price: object = "185.25",
+) -> None:
+    conn.execute(
+        "INSERT INTO fills("
+        "fill_id, account_scope_id, external_activity_id, broker_order_id, symbol, side, "
+        "quantity, price, fee, filled_at, recorded_at"
+        ") VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'AAPL', 'BUY', '1', ?, '0', ?, ?)",
+        (fill_id, scope_id, activity_id, order_id, price, STAMP, STAMP),
+    )
+
+
+def _event(conn: sqlite3.Connection, scope_id: str, event_id: str = "event-1") -> None:
+    conn.execute(
+        "INSERT INTO domain_events("
+        "event_id, account_scope_id, stream_type, stream_id, stream_version, event_type, "
+        "payload_json, payload_sha256, occurred_at, recorded_at"
+        ") VALUES (?, ?, 'cycle', 'cycle-1', 1, 'CycleOpened', '{}', ?, ?, ?)",
+        (event_id, scope_id, "0" * 64, STAMP, STAMP),
+    )
+
+
+def test_fresh_apply_configures_connection_and_creates_expected_tables(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    conn = initialize_database(tmp_path / "fresh.db", "PAPER", now=NOW)
+    try:
+        assert current_schema_version(conn) == 1
+        assert conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode").fetchone()[0].lower() == "wal"
+        assert conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys").fetchone()[0] == 1
+        assert conn.execute("PRAGMA synchronous").fetchone()[0] == 2
+        tables = {
+            row[0]
+            for row in conn.execute(
+                "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'"
+            )
+        }
+        assert EXPECTED_TABLES <= tables
+    finally:
+        conn.close()
+
+
+def test_read_only_connection_rejects_writes(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    path = tmp_path / "readonly.db"
+    initialize_database(path, "PAPER", now=NOW).close()
+    conn = open_connection(path, read_only=True)
+    try:
+        assert conn.execute("PRAGMA query_only").fetchone()[0] == 1
+        with pytest.raises(sqlite3.OperationalError):
+            conn.execute(
+                "INSERT INTO account_scopes("
+                "account_scope_id, environment, broker_account_ref, created_at"
+                ") VALUES ('paper:x', 'PAPER', 'x', ?)",
+                (STAMP,),
+            )
+    finally:
+        conn.close()
+
+
+def test_reapplying_migrations_is_a_no_op(connection: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
+    before = connection.execute("SELECT * FROM schema_migrations").fetchall()
+    apply_migrations(connection, now=NOW + timedelta(days=1))
+    assert connection.execute("SELECT * FROM schema_migrations").fetchall() == before
+
+
+def test_changed_applied_migration_checksum_raises(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    migrations_dir = tmp_path / "migrations"
+    migrations_dir.mkdir()
+    source = discover_migrations()[0].path
+    target = migrations_dir / source.name
+    shutil.copyfile(source, target)
+    conn = open_connection(tmp_path / "checksum.db")
+    try:
+        apply_migrations(conn, migrations_dir, now=NOW)
+        target.write_text(target.read_text(encoding="utf-8") + "\n-- tampered\n", encoding="utf-8")
+        with pytest.raises(MigrationChecksumError):
+            apply_migrations(conn, migrations_dir, now=NOW)
+    finally:
+        conn.close()
+
+
+def test_database_newer_than_known_migrations_raises(connection: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
+    connection.execute("UPDATE schema_migrations SET version = 2 WHERE version = 1")
+    with pytest.raises(SchemaTooNewError):
+        apply_migrations(connection, now=NOW)
+
+
+def test_broken_migration_rolls_back_every_object(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    migrations_dir = tmp_path / "broken_migrations"
+    migrations_dir.mkdir()
+    (migrations_dir / "0001_broken.sql").write_text(
+        "CREATE TABLE schema_migrations ("
+        "version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, sha256 TEXT, applied_at TEXT);\n"
+        "CREATE TABLE partial_object (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY);\n"
+        "THIS IS NOT VALID SQL;\n",
+        encoding="utf-8",
+    )
+    conn = open_connection(tmp_path / "broken.db")
+    try:
+        with pytest.raises(sqlite3.Error):
+            apply_migrations(conn, migrations_dir, now=NOW)
+        objects = {
+            row[0]
+            for row in conn.execute(
+                "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type IN ('table', 'index', 'trigger')"
+            )
+        }
+        assert "partial_object" not in objects
+        assert "schema_migrations" not in objects
+        assert current_schema_version(conn) == 0
+    finally:
+        conn.close()
+
+
+def test_account_scope_must_match_database_environment(connection: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
+    with pytest.raises(sqlite3.IntegrityError, match="environment differs"):
+        connection.execute(
+            "INSERT INTO account_scopes("
+            "account_scope_id, environment, broker, run_id, created_at"
+            ") VALUES ('backtest:wrong', 'BACKTEST', 'simulated', 'run-1', ?)",
+            (STAMP,),
+        )
+
+
+def test_initialize_rejects_existing_database_for_other_environment(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    path = tmp_path / "identity.db"
+    initialize_database(path, "PAPER", now=NOW).close()
+    with pytest.raises(DatabaseIdentityMismatchError):
+        initialize_database(path, "LIVE", now=NOW)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("verb", ["UPDATE", "DELETE"])
+def test_db_identity_is_immutable(connection: sqlite3.Connection, verb: str) -> None:
+    statement = (
+        "UPDATE db_identity SET database_id = 'changed' WHERE id = 1"
+        if verb == "UPDATE"
+        else "DELETE FROM db_identity WHERE id = 1"
+    )
+    with pytest.raises(sqlite3.IntegrityError, match="immutable: db_identity"):
+        connection.execute(statement)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("table", ["fills", "domain_events"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("verb", ["UPDATE", "DELETE"])
+def test_fill_and_domain_event_rows_are_append_only(
+    connection: sqlite3.Connection, table: str, verb: str
+) -> None:
+    _scope(connection, "shadow:one")
+    if table == "fills":
+        _broker_order(connection, "shadow:one", "order-1")
+        _fill(connection, "shadow:one", "fill-1", "activity-1", "order-1")
+        key_column, key = "fill_id", "fill-1"
+    else:
+        _event(connection, "shadow:one")
+        key_column, key = "event_id", "event-1"
+    statement = (
+        f"UPDATE {table} SET recorded_at = recorded_at WHERE {key_column} = ?"
+        if verb == "UPDATE"
+        else f"DELETE FROM {table} WHERE {key_column} = ?"
+    )
+    with pytest.raises(sqlite3.IntegrityError, match=f"append-only: {table}"):
+        connection.execute(statement, (key,))
+
+
+def test_duplicate_fill_external_activity_is_rejected(connection: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
+    _scope(connection, "shadow:one")
+    _broker_order(connection, "shadow:one", "order-1")
+    _fill(connection, "shadow:one", "fill-1", "activity-1", "order-1")
+    with pytest.raises(sqlite3.IntegrityError):
+        _fill(connection, "shadow:one", "fill-2", "activity-1", "order-1")
+
+
+def test_fill_cannot_reference_broker_order_in_another_scope(
+    connection: sqlite3.Connection,
+) -> None:
+    _scope(connection, "shadow:one")
+    _scope(connection, "shadow:two")
+    _broker_order(connection, "shadow:one", "order-1")
+    with pytest.raises(sqlite3.IntegrityError, match="FOREIGN KEY"):
+        _fill(connection, "shadow:two", "fill-1", "activity-1", "order-1")

+def test_non_text_money_value_fails_type_check(connection: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
+    _scope(connection, "shadow:one")
+    _broker_order(connection, "shadow:one", "order-1")

+def test_schema_has_no_tick_quote_or_raw_trade_archive(connection: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
+    table_names = {

+        for row in connection.execute(

+def test_domain_events_columns_match_shared_contract(connection: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
+    columns = [row[1] for row in connection.execute("PRAGMA table_info(domain_events)")]
+    assert columns == [
+        "event_seq",
+        "event_id",

+        "stream_id",
+        "stream_version",
+        "event_type",
+        "payload_json",
+        "payload_sha256",
+        "idempotency_key",
+        "causation_id",
+        "correlation_id",
+        "occurred_at",
+        "recorded_at",
+    ]
+
+
+def test_timestamp_helpers_are_utc_and_fixed_width() -> None:
+    offset_value = datetime(
+        2026, 10, 8, 10, 30, 1, 123456, tzinfo=timezone(timedelta(hours=-4))
+    )
+    assert to_db_timestamp(offset_value) == STAMP
+    assert from_db_timestamp(STAMP) == NOW
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="timezone-aware"):
+        to_db_timestamp(datetime(2026, 10, 8))
+
+
+def test_decimal_helpers_require_finite_decimals() -> None:
+    assert decimal_to_db(Decimal("1.2300")) == "1.2300"
+    assert decimal_from_db("1.2300") == Decimal("1.2300")
+    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
+        decimal_to_db(1.23)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="finite"):
+        decimal_to_db(Decimal("NaN"))
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="finite"):
+        decimal_from_db("Infinity")

+"""SQLite connection, migration, and scalar-persistence helpers.
+
+Design choices (4, the task's decision budget):
+1. ``discover_migrations`` returns immutable private records containing the
+   version, unprefixed name, path, text, and text checksum.
+2. Migration names stored in ``schema_migrations`` omit the numeric prefix and
+   ``.sql`` suffix (for example, ``initial``).
+3. Database environments may be supplied as either ``AccountEnvironment``
+   values or their uppercase strings, keeping this infrastructure boundary
+   convenient without duplicating the domain enum.
+4. Decimal reads reject non-finite values just as decimal writes do, so corrupt
+   persisted numeric text cannot silently enter the domain.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import re
+import sqlite3
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Final
+from uuid import uuid4
+
+from mike_trade.domain.accounts import AccountEnvironment
+from mike_trade.domain.errors import PersistenceError
+
+__all__ = [
+    "open_connection",
+    "discover_migrations",
+    "apply_migrations",
+    "current_schema_version",
+    "initialize_database",
+    "to_db_timestamp",
+    "from_db_timestamp",
+    "decimal_to_db",
+    "decimal_from_db",
+    "EXPECTED_TABLES",
+    "MigrationChecksumError",
+    "SchemaTooNewError",
+    "DatabaseIdentityMismatchError",
+]
+
+
+class MigrationChecksumError(PersistenceError):
+    """An applied migration no longer has its recorded contents."""
+
+
+class SchemaTooNewError(PersistenceError):
+    """The database was migrated by a newer version of the application."""
+
+
+class DatabaseIdentityMismatchError(PersistenceError):
+    """The database identity does not match the requested environment."""
+
+
+EXPECTED_TABLES: Final[frozenset[str]] = frozenset(
+    {
+        "schema_migrations",
+        "db_identity",
+        "account_scopes",
+        "run_configs",
+        "operator_commands",
+        "service_health",
+        "instruments",
+        "instrument_capabilities",
+        "market_bars",
+        "strategy_instances",
+        "strategy_evaluations",
+        "signals",
+        "decisions",
+        "position_cycles",
+        "budget_reservations",
+        "order_intents",
+        "broker_orders",
+        "broker_order_events",
+        "fills",
+        "broker_activities",
+        "protection_orders",
+        "trailing_stop_states",
+        "trailing_stop_events",
+        "positions",
+        "cash_events",
+        "equity_snapshots",
+        "reconciliation_runs",
+        "reconciliation_drifts",
+        "reconciliation_resolutions",
+        "strategy_state",
+        "entry_eligibility_counters",
+        "entry_lockouts",
+        "entry_cooldowns",
+        "entry_controls",
+        "backtest_manifests",
+        "domain_events",
+    }
+)
+
+_MIGRATION_RE = re.compile(r"^(?P<version>[0-9]{4})_(?P<name>[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\.sql$")
+_ENVIRONMENTS = frozenset(item.value for item in AccountEnvironment)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class _Migration:
+    version: int
+    name: str
+    path: Path
+    text: str
+    sha256: str
+
+
+def open_connection(path: str | Path, *, read_only: bool = False) -> sqlite3.Connection:
+    """Open a configured SQLite connection for an operational database."""
+    database_path = Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
+    if read_only:
+        uri = f"{database_path.as_uri()}?mode=ro"
+        conn = sqlite3.connect(uri, uri=True, isolation_level=None)
+        try:
+            conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
+            conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000")
+            conn.execute("PRAGMA query_only = ON")
+        except BaseException:
+            conn.close()
+            raise
+        return conn
+
+    conn = sqlite3.connect(database_path, isolation_level=None)
+    try:
+        conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
+        mode = str(conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL").fetchone()[0]).lower()
+        if mode != "wal":
+            raise PersistenceError(f"SQLite refused WAL mode for {database_path}: {mode!r}")
+        conn.execute("PRAGMA synchronous = FULL")
+        conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000")
+    except BaseException:
+        conn.close()
+        raise
+    return conn
+
+
+def discover_migrations(migrations_dir: str | Path | None = None) -> tuple[_Migration, ...]:
+    """Read a complete, consecutively numbered set of forward migrations."""
+    directory = (
+        Path(migrations_dir)
+        if migrations_dir is not None
+        else Path(__file__).parent / "migrations"
+    )
+    discovered: list[_Migration] = []
+    versions: set[int] = set()
+    paths = directory.iterdir() if directory.is_dir() else ()
+    for path in sorted(paths, key=lambda item: item.name):
+        match = _MIGRATION_RE.fullmatch(path.name)
+        if match is None or not path.is_file():
+            continue
+        version = int(match.group("version"))
+        if version in versions:
+            raise PersistenceError(f"duplicate migration version {version:04d} in {directory}")
+        versions.add(version)
+        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+        discovered.append(
+            _Migration(
+                version=version,
+                name=match.group("name"),
+                path=path,
+                text=text,
+                sha256=hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
+            )
+        )
+    discovered.sort(key=lambda migration: migration.version)
+    actual = [migration.version for migration in discovered]
+    expected = list(range(1, len(discovered) + 1))
+    if actual != expected:
+        raise PersistenceError(
+            f"migration versions must be consecutive starting at 0001; found {actual}"
+        )
+    return tuple(discovered)
+
+
+def _schema_migrations_exists(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> bool:
+    row = conn.execute(
+        "SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'schema_migrations'"
+    ).fetchone()
+    return row is not None
+
+
+def current_schema_version(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> int:
+    """Return the greatest applied migration version, or zero for a fresh DB."""
+    if not _schema_migrations_exists(conn):
+        return 0
+    row = conn.execute("SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) FROM schema_migrations").fetchone()
+    return int(row[0])
+
+
+def _migration_statements(text: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+    """Split SQL without losing trigger bodies; unlike executescript, do not commit."""
+    statements: list[str] = []
+    buffer = ""
+    for character in text:
+        buffer += character
+        if character == ";" and sqlite3.complete_statement(buffer):
+            if buffer.strip():
+                statements.append(buffer)
+            buffer = ""
+    remaining_lines = (line for line in buffer.splitlines() if line.strip())
+    if buffer.strip() and not all(line.lstrip().startswith("--") for line in remaining_lines):
+        if not sqlite3.complete_statement(buffer):
+            raise sqlite3.OperationalError("incomplete SQL at end of migration")
+        statements.append(buffer)
+    return tuple(statements)
+
+
+def apply_migrations(
+    conn: sqlite3.Connection,
+    migrations_dir: str | Path | None = None,
+    *,
+    now: datetime,
+) -> None:
+    """Verify applied migration contents and atomically apply each pending file."""
+    migrations = discover_migrations(migrations_dir)
+    current = current_schema_version(conn)
+    highest_known = migrations[-1].version if migrations else 0
+    if current > highest_known:
+        raise SchemaTooNewError(
+            f"database schema version {current} exceeds highest known version {highest_known}"
+        )
+
+    applied: dict[int, tuple[str, str]] = {}
+    if _schema_migrations_exists(conn):
+        rows = conn.execute("SELECT version, name, sha256 FROM schema_migrations").fetchall()
+        applied = {int(version): (str(name), str(checksum)) for version, name, checksum in rows}
+    known_by_version = {migration.version: migration for migration in migrations}
+    unknown_applied = sorted(set(applied) - set(known_by_version))
+    if unknown_applied:
+        raise SchemaTooNewError(f"database contains unknown migration versions: {unknown_applied}")
+    for version, (_, recorded_checksum) in applied.items():
+        migration = known_by_version[version]
+        if recorded_checksum != migration.sha256:
+            raise MigrationChecksumError(
+                f"migration {version:04d}_{migration.name}.sql checksum does not match database"
+            )
+
+    applied_at = to_db_timestamp(now)
+    for migration in migrations:
+        if migration.version in applied:
+            continue
+        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+        try:
+            for statement in _migration_statements(migration.text):
+                conn.execute(statement)
+            conn.execute(
+                "INSERT INTO schema_migrations(version, name, sha256, applied_at) "
+                "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
+                (migration.version, migration.name, migration.sha256, applied_at),
+            )
+            conn.execute("COMMIT")
+        except BaseException:
+            if conn.in_transaction:
+                conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
+            raise
+
+
+def _environment_value(environment: AccountEnvironment | str) -> str:
+    value = environment.value if isinstance(environment, AccountEnvironment) else environment
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or value not in _ENVIRONMENTS:
+        raise ValueError(f"environment must be one of {sorted(_ENVIRONMENTS)}")
+    return value
+
+
+def initialize_database(
+    path: str | Path,
+    environment: AccountEnvironment | str,
+    *,
+    now: datetime,
+) -> sqlite3.Connection:
+    """Open, migrate, and bind a database permanently to one environment."""
+    expected_environment = _environment_value(environment)
+    conn = open_connection(path)
+    try:
+        apply_migrations(conn, now=now)
+        created_at = to_db_timestamp(now)
+        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+        try:
+            identity = conn.execute(
+                "SELECT environment FROM db_identity WHERE id = 1"
+            ).fetchone()
+            if identity is None:
+                conn.execute(
+                    "INSERT INTO db_identity(id, environment, database_id, created_at) "
+                    "VALUES (1, ?, ?, ?)",
+                    (expected_environment, str(uuid4()), created_at),
+                )
+            elif identity[0] != expected_environment:
+                raise DatabaseIdentityMismatchError(
+                    f"database environment is {identity[0]!r}, not {expected_environment!r}"
+                )
+            conn.execute("COMMIT")
+        except BaseException:
+            if conn.in_transaction:
+                conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
+            raise
+    except BaseException:
+        conn.close()
+        raise
+    return conn
+
+
+def to_db_timestamp(value: datetime) -> str:
+    """Serialize an aware datetime as fixed-width microsecond UTC text."""
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError("database timestamps require a timezone-aware datetime")
+    return value.astimezone(UTC).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ")
+
+
+def from_db_timestamp(text: str) -> datetime:
+    """Parse the database's fixed-width UTC timestamp representation."""
+    if not isinstance(text, str):
+        raise TypeError("database timestamp must be str")
+    try:
+        return datetime.strptime(text, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ").replace(tzinfo=UTC)
+    except ValueError as error:
+        raise ValueError(f"invalid database timestamp: {text!r}") from error
+
+
+def decimal_to_db(value: Decimal) -> str:
+    """Serialize a finite Decimal without accepting lossy float input."""
+    if not isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        raise TypeError("database decimal value must be Decimal")
+    if not value.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError("database decimal value must be finite")
+    return str(value)
+
+
+def decimal_from_db(text: str) -> Decimal:
+    """Parse finite decimal text from SQLite."""
+    if not isinstance(text, str):
+        raise TypeError("database decimal value must be str")
+    try:
+        value = Decimal(text)
+    except InvalidOperation as error:
+        raise ValueError(f"invalid database decimal: {text!r}") from error
+    if not value.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError("database decimal value must be finite")
+    return value
