@@ -0,0 +1,344 @@
+"""SQLite connection, migration, and scalar-persistence helpers.
+
+Design choices (4, the task's decision budget):
+1. ``discover_migrations`` returns immutable private records containing the
+   version, unprefixed name, path, text, and text checksum.
+2. Migration names stored in ``schema_migrations`` omit the numeric prefix and
+   ``.sql`` suffix (for example, ``initial``).
+3. Database environments may be supplied as either ``AccountEnvironment``
+   values or their uppercase strings, keeping this infrastructure boundary
+   convenient without duplicating the domain enum.
+4. Decimal reads reject non-finite values just as decimal writes do, so corrupt
+   persisted numeric text cannot silently enter the domain.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import re
+import sqlite3
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Final
+from uuid import uuid4
+
+from mike_trade.domain.accounts import AccountEnvironment
+from mike_trade.domain.errors import PersistenceError
+
+__all__ = [
+    "open_connection",
+    "discover_migrations",
+    "apply_migrations",
+    "current_schema_version",
+    "initialize_database",
+    "to_db_timestamp",
+    "from_db_timestamp",
+    "decimal_to_db",
+    "decimal_from_db",
+    "EXPECTED_TABLES",
+    "MigrationChecksumError",
+    "SchemaTooNewError",
+    "DatabaseIdentityMismatchError",
+]
+
+
+class MigrationChecksumError(PersistenceError):
+    """An applied migration no longer has its recorded contents."""
+
+
+class SchemaTooNewError(PersistenceError):
+    """The database was migrated by a newer version of the application."""
+
+
+class DatabaseIdentityMismatchError(PersistenceError):
+    """The database identity does not match the requested environment."""
+
+
+EXPECTED_TABLES: Final[frozenset[str]] = frozenset(
+    {
+        "schema_migrations",
+        "db_identity",
+        "account_scopes",
+        "run_configs",
+        "operator_commands",
+        "service_health",
+        "instruments",
+        "instrument_capabilities",
+        "market_bars",
+        "strategy_instances",
+        "strategy_evaluations",
+        "signals",
+        "decisions",
+        "position_cycles",
+        "budget_reservations",
+        "order_intents",
+        "broker_orders",
+        "broker_order_events",
+        "fills",
+        "broker_activities",
+        "protection_orders",
+        "trailing_stop_states",
+        "trailing_stop_events",
+        "positions",
+        "cash_events",
+        "equity_snapshots",
+        "reconciliation_runs",
+        "reconciliation_drifts",
+        "reconciliation_resolutions",
+        "strategy_state",
+        "entry_eligibility_counters",
+        "entry_lockouts",
+        "entry_cooldowns",
+        "entry_controls",
+        "backtest_manifests",
+        "domain_events",
+    }
+)
+
+_MIGRATION_RE = re.compile(r"^(?P<version>[0-9]{4})_(?P<name>[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\.sql$")
+_ENVIRONMENTS = frozenset(item.value for item in AccountEnvironment)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class _Migration:
+    version: int
+    name: str
+    path: Path
+    text: str
+    sha256: str
+
+
+def open_connection(path: str | Path, *, read_only: bool = False) -> sqlite3.Connection:
+    """Open a configured SQLite connection for an operational database."""
+    database_path = Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
+    if read_only:
+        uri = f"{database_path.as_uri()}?mode=ro"
+        conn = sqlite3.connect(uri, uri=True, isolation_level=None)
+        try:
+            conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
+            conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000")
+            conn.execute("PRAGMA query_only = ON")
+        except BaseException:
+            conn.close()
+            raise
+        return conn
+
+    conn = sqlite3.connect(database_path, isolation_level=None)
+    try:
+        conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
+        mode = str(conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL").fetchone()[0]).lower()
+        if mode != "wal":
+            raise PersistenceError(f"SQLite refused WAL mode for {database_path}: {mode!r}")
+        conn.execute("PRAGMA synchronous = FULL")
+        conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000")
+    except BaseException:
+        conn.close()
+        raise
+    return conn
+
+
+def discover_migrations(migrations_dir: str | Path | None = None) -> tuple[_Migration, ...]:
+    """Read a complete, consecutively numbered set of forward migrations."""
+    directory = (
+        Path(migrations_dir)
+        if migrations_dir is not None
+        else Path(__file__).parent / "migrations"
+    )
+    discovered: list[_Migration] = []
+    versions: set[int] = set()
+    paths = directory.iterdir() if directory.is_dir() else ()
+    for path in sorted(paths, key=lambda item: item.name):
+        match = _MIGRATION_RE.fullmatch(path.name)
+        if match is None or not path.is_file():
+            continue
+        version = int(match.group("version"))
+        if version in versions:
+            raise PersistenceError(f"duplicate migration version {version:04d} in {directory}")
+        versions.add(version)
+        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+        discovered.append(
+            _Migration(
+                version=version,
+                name=match.group("name"),
+                path=path,
+                text=text,
+                sha256=hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
+            )
+        )
+    discovered.sort(key=lambda migration: migration.version)
+    actual = [migration.version for migration in discovered]
+    expected = list(range(1, len(discovered) + 1))
+    if actual != expected:
+        raise PersistenceError(
+            f"migration versions must be consecutive starting at 0001; found {actual}"
+        )
+    return tuple(discovered)
+
+
+def _schema_migrations_exists(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> bool:
+    row = conn.execute(
+        "SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'schema_migrations'"
+    ).fetchone()
+    return row is not None
+
+
+def current_schema_version(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> int:
+    """Return the greatest applied migration version, or zero for a fresh DB."""
+    if not _schema_migrations_exists(conn):
+        return 0
+    row = conn.execute("SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) FROM schema_migrations").fetchone()
+    return int(row[0])
+
+
+def _migration_statements(text: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+    """Split SQL without losing trigger bodies; unlike executescript, do not commit."""
+    statements: list[str] = []
+    buffer = ""
+    for character in text:
+        buffer += character
+        if character == ";" and sqlite3.complete_statement(buffer):
+            if buffer.strip():
+                statements.append(buffer)
+            buffer = ""
+    remaining_lines = (line for line in buffer.splitlines() if line.strip())
+    if buffer.strip() and not all(line.lstrip().startswith("--") for line in remaining_lines):
+        if not sqlite3.complete_statement(buffer):
+            raise sqlite3.OperationalError("incomplete SQL at end of migration")
+        statements.append(buffer)
+    return tuple(statements)
+
+
+def apply_migrations(
+    conn: sqlite3.Connection,
+    migrations_dir: str | Path | None = None,
+    *,
+    now: datetime,
+) -> None:
+    """Verify applied migration contents and atomically apply each pending file."""
+    migrations = discover_migrations(migrations_dir)
+    current = current_schema_version(conn)
+    highest_known = migrations[-1].version if migrations else 0
+    if current > highest_known:
+        raise SchemaTooNewError(
+            f"database schema version {current} exceeds highest known version {highest_known}"
+        )
+
+    applied: dict[int, tuple[str, str]] = {}
+    if _schema_migrations_exists(conn):
+        rows = conn.execute("SELECT version, name, sha256 FROM schema_migrations").fetchall()
+        applied = {int(version): (str(name), str(checksum)) for version, name, checksum in rows}
+    known_by_version = {migration.version: migration for migration in migrations}
+    unknown_applied = sorted(set(applied) - set(known_by_version))
+    if unknown_applied:
+        raise SchemaTooNewError(f"database contains unknown migration versions: {unknown_applied}")
+    for version, (_, recorded_checksum) in applied.items():
+        migration = known_by_version[version]
+        if recorded_checksum != migration.sha256:
+            raise MigrationChecksumError(
+                f"migration {version:04d}_{migration.name}.sql checksum does not match database"
+            )
+
+    applied_at = to_db_timestamp(now)
+    for migration in migrations:
+        if migration.version in applied:
+            continue
+        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+        try:
+            for statement in _migration_statements(migration.text):
+                conn.execute(statement)
+            conn.execute(
+                "INSERT INTO schema_migrations(version, name, sha256, applied_at) "
+                "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
+                (migration.version, migration.name, migration.sha256, applied_at),
+            )
+            conn.execute("COMMIT")
+        except BaseException:
+            if conn.in_transaction:
+                conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
+            raise
+
+
+def _environment_value(environment: AccountEnvironment | str) -> str:
+    value = environment.value if isinstance(environment, AccountEnvironment) else environment
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or value not in _ENVIRONMENTS:
+        raise ValueError(f"environment must be one of {sorted(_ENVIRONMENTS)}")
+    return value
+
+
+def initialize_database(
+    path: str | Path,
+    environment: AccountEnvironment | str,
+    *,
+    now: datetime,
+) -> sqlite3.Connection:
+    """Open, migrate, and bind a database permanently to one environment."""
+    expected_environment = _environment_value(environment)
+    conn = open_connection(path)
+    try:
+        apply_migrations(conn, now=now)
+        created_at = to_db_timestamp(now)
+        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+        try:
+            identity = conn.execute(
+                "SELECT environment FROM db_identity WHERE id = 1"
+            ).fetchone()
+            if identity is None:
+                conn.execute(
+                    "INSERT INTO db_identity(id, environment, database_id, created_at) "
+                    "VALUES (1, ?, ?, ?)",
+                    (expected_environment, str(uuid4()), created_at),
+                )
+            elif identity[0] != expected_environment:
+                raise DatabaseIdentityMismatchError(
+                    f"database environment is {identity[0]!r}, not {expected_environment!r}"
+                )
+            conn.execute("COMMIT")
+        except BaseException:
+            if conn.in_transaction:
+                conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
+            raise
+    except BaseException:
+        conn.close()
+        raise
+    return conn
+
+
+def to_db_timestamp(value: datetime) -> str:
+    """Serialize an aware datetime as fixed-width microsecond UTC text."""
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError("database timestamps require a timezone-aware datetime")
+    return value.astimezone(UTC).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ")
+
+
+def from_db_timestamp(text: str) -> datetime:
+    """Parse the database's fixed-width UTC timestamp representation."""
+    if not isinstance(text, str):
+        raise TypeError("database timestamp must be str")
+    try:
+        return datetime.strptime(text, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ").replace(tzinfo=UTC)
+    except ValueError as error:
+        raise ValueError(f"invalid database timestamp: {text!r}") from error
+
+
+def decimal_to_db(value: Decimal) -> str:
+    """Serialize a finite Decimal without accepting lossy float input."""
+    if not isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        raise TypeError("database decimal value must be Decimal")
+    if not value.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError("database decimal value must be finite")
+    return str(value)
+
+
+def decimal_from_db(text: str) -> Decimal:
+    """Parse finite decimal text from SQLite."""
+    if not isinstance(text, str):
+        raise TypeError("database decimal value must be str")
+    try:
+        value = Decimal(text)
+    except InvalidOperation as error:
+        raise ValueError(f"invalid database decimal: {text!r}") from error
+    if not value.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError("database decimal value must be finite")
+    return value

+CREATE TABLE schema_migrations (

+  database_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
+  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
+);
+
+CREATE TRIGGER db_identity_no_update
+BEFORE UPDATE ON db_identity
+BEGIN
+  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'immutable: db_identity');
+END;
+
+CREATE TRIGGER db_identity_no_delete
+BEFORE DELETE ON db_identity
+BEGIN
+  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'immutable: db_identity');
+END;
+
+CREATE TABLE account_scopes (
+  account_scope_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+  environment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (environment IN ('LIVE','PAPER','SHADOW','BACKTEST')),

+  scenario_name TEXT,
+  run_id TEXT,
+  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
+  CHECK (environment <> 'SHADOW' OR scenario_name IS NOT NULL),
+  CHECK (environment <> 'BACKTEST' OR run_id IS NOT NULL),
+  CHECK (environment NOT IN ('LIVE','PAPER') OR broker_account_ref IS NOT NULL)
+);
+

+BEFORE INSERT ON account_scopes
+WHEN (SELECT environment FROM db_identity WHERE id = 1) IS NULL
+  OR NEW.environment <> (SELECT environment FROM db_identity WHERE id = 1)

+"""SQLite connection, migration, and scalar-persistence helpers.
+
+Design choices (4, the task's decision budget):
+1. ``discover_migrations`` returns immutable private records containing the
+   version, unprefixed name, path, text, and text checksum.
+2. Migration names stored in ``schema_migrations`` omit the numeric prefix and
+   ``.sql`` suffix (for example, ``initial``).
+3. Database environments may be supplied as either ``AccountEnvironment``
+   values or their uppercase strings, keeping this infrastructure boundary
+   convenient without duplicating the domain enum.
+4. Decimal reads reject non-finite values just as decimal writes do, so corrupt
+   persisted numeric text cannot silently enter the domain.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import re
+import sqlite3
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Final
+from uuid import uuid4
+
+from mike_trade.domain.accounts import AccountEnvironment
+from mike_trade.domain.errors import PersistenceError
+
+__all__ = [
+    "open_connection",
+    "discover_migrations",
+    "apply_migrations",
+    "current_schema_version",
+    "initialize_database",
+    "to_db_timestamp",
+    "from_db_timestamp",
+    "decimal_to_db",
+    "decimal_from_db",
+    "EXPECTED_TABLES",
+    "MigrationChecksumError",
+    "SchemaTooNewError",
+    "DatabaseIdentityMismatchError",
+]
+
+
+class MigrationChecksumError(PersistenceError):
+    """An applied migration no longer has its recorded contents."""
+
+
+class SchemaTooNewError(PersistenceError):
+    """The database was migrated by a newer version of the application."""
+
+
+class DatabaseIdentityMismatchError(PersistenceError):
+    """The database identity does not match the requested environment."""
+
+
+EXPECTED_TABLES: Final[frozenset[str]] = frozenset(
+    {
+        "schema_migrations",
+        "db_identity",
+        "account_scopes",
+        "run_configs",
+        "operator_commands",
+        "service_health",
+        "instruments",
+        "instrument_capabilities",
+        "market_bars",
+        "strategy_instances",
+        "strategy_evaluations",
+        "signals",
+        "decisions",
+        "position_cycles",
+        "budget_reservations",
+        "order_intents",
+        "broker_orders",
+        "broker_order_events",
+        "fills",
+        "broker_activities",
+        "protection_orders",
+        "trailing_stop_states",
+        "trailing_stop_events",
+        "positions",
+        "cash_events",
+        "equity_snapshots",
+        "reconciliation_runs",
+        "reconciliation_drifts",
+        "reconciliation_resolutions",
+        "strategy_state",
+        "entry_eligibility_counters",
+        "entry_lockouts",
+        "entry_cooldowns",
+        "entry_controls",
+        "backtest_manifests",
+        "domain_events",
+    }
+)
+
+_MIGRATION_RE = re.compile(r"^(?P<version>[0-9]{4})_(?P<name>[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\.sql$")
+_ENVIRONMENTS = frozenset(item.value for item in AccountEnvironment)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class _Migration:
+    version: int
+    name: str
+    path: Path
+    text: str
+    sha256: str
+
+
+def open_connection(path: str | Path, *, read_only: bool = False) -> sqlite3.Connection:
+    """Open a configured SQLite connection for an operational database."""
+    database_path = Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
+    if read_only:
+        uri = f"{database_path.as_uri()}?mode=ro"
+        conn = sqlite3.connect(uri, uri=True, isolation_level=None)
+        try:
+            conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
+            conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000")
+            conn.execute("PRAGMA query_only = ON")
+        except BaseException:
+            conn.close()
+            raise
+        return conn
+
+    conn = sqlite3.connect(database_path, isolation_level=None)
+    try:
+        conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
+        mode = str(conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL").fetchone()[0]).lower()
+        if mode != "wal":
+            raise PersistenceError(f"SQLite refused WAL mode for {database_path}: {mode!r}")
+        conn.execute("PRAGMA synchronous = FULL")
+        conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000")
+    except BaseException:
+        conn.close()
+        raise
+    return conn
+
+
+def discover_migrations(migrations_dir: str | Path | None = None) -> tuple[_Migration, ...]:
+    """Read a complete, consecutively numbered set of forward migrations."""
+    directory = (
+        Path(migrations_dir)
+        if migrations_dir is not None
+        else Path(__file__).parent / "migrations"
+    )
+    discovered: list[_Migration] = []
+    versions: set[int] = set()
+    paths = directory.iterdir() if directory.is_dir() else ()
+    for path in sorted(paths, key=lambda item: item.name):
+        match = _MIGRATION_RE.fullmatch(path.name)
+        if match is None or not path.is_file():
+            continue
+        version = int(match.group("version"))
+        if version in versions:
+            raise PersistenceError(f"duplicate migration version {version:04d} in {directory}")
+        versions.add(version)
+        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+        discovered.append(
+            _Migration(
+                version=version,
+                name=match.group("name"),
+                path=path,
+                text=text,
+                sha256=hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
+            )
+        )
+    discovered.sort(key=lambda migration: migration.version)
+    actual = [migration.version for migration in discovered]
+    expected = list(range(1, len(discovered) + 1))
+    if actual != expected:
+        raise PersistenceError(
+            f"migration versions must be consecutive starting at 0001; found {actual}"
+        )
+    return tuple(discovered)
+
+
+def _schema_migrations_exists(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> bool:
+    row = conn.execute(
+        "SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'schema_migrations'"
+    ).fetchone()
+    return row is not None
+
+
+def current_schema_version(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> int:
+    """Return the greatest applied migration version, or zero for a fresh DB."""
+    if not _schema_migrations_exists(conn):
+        return 0
+    row = conn.execute("SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) FROM schema_migrations").fetchone()
+    return int(row[0])
+
+
+def _migration_statements(text: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+    """Split SQL without losing trigger bodies; unlike executescript, do not commit."""
+    statements: list[str] = []
+    buffer = ""
+    for character in text:
+        buffer += character
+        if character == ";" and sqlite3.complete_statement(buffer):
+            if buffer.strip():
+                statements.append(buffer)
+            buffer = ""
+    remaining_lines = (line for line in buffer.splitlines() if line.strip())
+    if buffer.strip() and not all(line.lstrip().startswith("--") for line in remaining_lines):
+        if not sqlite3.complete_statement(buffer):
+            raise sqlite3.OperationalError("incomplete SQL at end of migration")
+        statements.append(buffer)
+    return tuple(statements)
+
+
+def apply_migrations(
+    conn: sqlite3.Connection,
+    migrations_dir: str | Path | None = None,
+    *,
+    now: datetime,
+) -> None:
+    """Verify applied migration contents and atomically apply each pending file."""
+    migrations = discover_migrations(migrations_dir)
+    current = current_schema_version(conn)
+    highest_known = migrations[-1].version if migrations else 0
+    if current > highest_known:
+        raise SchemaTooNewError(
+            f"database schema version {current} exceeds highest known version {highest_known}"
+        )
+
+    applied: dict[int, tuple[str, str]] = {}
+    if _schema_migrations_exists(conn):
+        rows = conn.execute("SELECT version, name, sha256 FROM schema_migrations").fetchall()
+        applied = {int(version): (str(name), str(checksum)) for version, name, checksum in rows}
+    known_by_version = {migration.version: migration for migration in migrations}
+    unknown_applied = sorted(set(applied) - set(known_by_version))
+    if unknown_applied:
+        raise SchemaTooNewError(f"database contains unknown migration versions: {unknown_applied}")
+    for version, (_, recorded_checksum) in applied.items():
+        migration = known_by_version[version]
+        if recorded_checksum != migration.sha256:
+            raise MigrationChecksumError(
+                f"migration {version:04d}_{migration.name}.sql checksum does not match database"
+            )
+
+    applied_at = to_db_timestamp(now)
+    for migration in migrations:
+        if migration.version in applied:
+            continue
+        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+        try:
+            for statement in _migration_statements(migration.text):
+                conn.execute(statement)
+            conn.execute(
+                "INSERT INTO schema_migrations(version, name, sha256, applied_at) "
+                "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
+                (migration.version, migration.name, migration.sha256, applied_at),
+            )
+            conn.execute("COMMIT")
+        except BaseException:
+            if conn.in_transaction:
+                conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
+            raise
+
+
+def _environment_value(environment: AccountEnvironment | str) -> str:
+    value = environment.value if isinstance(environment, AccountEnvironment) else environment
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or value not in _ENVIRONMENTS:
+        raise ValueError(f"environment must be one of {sorted(_ENVIRONMENTS)}")
+    return value
+
+
+def initialize_database(
+    path: str | Path,
+    environment: AccountEnvironment | str,
+    *,
+    now: datetime,
+) -> sqlite3.Connection:
+    """Open, migrate, and bind a database permanently to one environment."""
+    expected_environment = _environment_value(environment)
+    conn = open_connection(path)
+    try:
+        apply_migrations(conn, now=now)
+        created_at = to_db_timestamp(now)
+        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+        try:
+            identity = conn.execute(
+                "SELECT environment FROM db_identity WHERE id = 1"
+            ).fetchone()
+            if identity is None:
+                conn.execute(
+                    "INSERT INTO db_identity(id, environment, database_id, created_at) "
+                    "VALUES (1, ?, ?, ?)",
+                    (expected_environment, str(uuid4()), created_at),
+                )
+            elif identity[0] != expected_environment:
+                raise DatabaseIdentityMismatchError(
+                    f"database environment is {identity[0]!r}, not {expected_environment!r}"
+                )
+            conn.execute("COMMIT")
+        except BaseException:
+            if conn.in_transaction:
+                conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
+            raise
+    except BaseException:
+        conn.close()
+        raise
+    return conn
+
+
+def to_db_timestamp(value: datetime) -> str:
+    """Serialize an aware datetime as fixed-width microsecond UTC text."""
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError("database timestamps require a timezone-aware datetime")
+    return value.astimezone(UTC).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ")
+
+
+def from_db_timestamp(text: str) -> datetime:
+    """Parse the database's fixed-width UTC timestamp representation."""
+    if not isinstance(text, str):
+        raise TypeError("database timestamp must be str")
+    try:
+        value = datetime.strptime(text, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ").replace(tzinfo=UTC)
+    except ValueError as error:
+        raise ValueError(f"invalid database timestamp: {text!r}") from error
+    if to_db_timestamp(value) != text:
+        raise ValueError(f"invalid database timestamp: {text!r}")
+    return value
+
+
+def decimal_to_db(value: Decimal) -> str:
+    """Serialize a finite Decimal without accepting lossy float input."""
+    if not isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        raise TypeError("database decimal value must be Decimal")
+    if not value.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError("database decimal value must be finite")
+    return str(value)
+
+
+def decimal_from_db(text: str) -> Decimal:
+    """Parse finite decimal text from SQLite."""
+    if not isinstance(text, str):
+        raise TypeError("database decimal value must be str")
+    try:
+        value = Decimal(text)
+    except InvalidOperation as error:
+        raise ValueError(f"invalid database decimal: {text!r}") from error
+    if not value.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError("database decimal value must be finite")
+    return value

+    with pytest.raises(sqlite3.IntegrityError, match=r"typeof\(price\)"):
+        _fill(
+            connection,
+            "shadow:one",
+            "fill-1",
+            "activity-1",
+            "order-1",
+            price=sqlite3.Binary(b"185.25"),
+        )
+
+
+def test_schema_has_no_tick_quote_or_raw_trade_archive(connection: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
+    table_names = {
+        row[0].lower()
+        for row in connection.execute(
+            "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'"
+        )
+    }
+    forbidden = {"ticks", "raw_ticks", "quotes", "trades_raw", "raw_trades"}
+    assert table_names.isdisjoint(forbidden)
+
+
+def test_domain_events_columns_match_shared_contract(connection: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
+    columns = [row[1] for row in connection.execute("PRAGMA table_info(domain_events)")]
+    assert columns == [
+        "event_seq",
+        "event_id",
+        "account_scope_id",
+        "stream_type",
+        "stream_id",
+        "stream_version",
+        "event_type",
+        "payload_json",
+        "payload_sha256",
+        "idempotency_key",
+        "causation_id",
+        "correlation_id",
+        "occurred_at",
+        "recorded_at",
+    ]
+
+
+def test_timestamp_helpers_are_utc_and_fixed_width() -> None:
+    offset_value = datetime(
+        2026, 10, 8, 10, 30, 1, 123456, tzinfo=timezone(timedelta(hours=-4))
+    )
+    assert to_db_timestamp(offset_value) == STAMP
+    assert from_db_timestamp(STAMP) == NOW
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="timezone-aware"):
+        to_db_timestamp(datetime(2026, 10, 8))
+
+
+def test_decimal_helpers_require_finite_decimals() -> None:
+    assert decimal_to_db(Decimal("1.2300")) == "1.2300"
+    assert decimal_from_db("1.2300") == Decimal("1.2300")
+    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
+        decimal_to_db(1.23)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="finite"):
+        decimal_to_db(Decimal("NaN"))
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="finite"):
+        decimal_from_db("Infinity")

+"""SQLite connection, migration, and scalar-persistence helpers.
+
+Design choices (4, the task's decision budget):
+1. ``discover_migrations`` returns immutable private records containing the
+   version, unprefixed name, path, text, and text checksum.
+2. Migration names stored in ``schema_migrations`` omit the numeric prefix and
+   ``.sql`` suffix (for example, ``initial``).
+3. Database environments may be supplied as either ``AccountEnvironment``
+   values or their uppercase strings, keeping this infrastructure boundary
+   convenient without duplicating the domain enum.
+4. Decimal reads reject non-finite values just as decimal writes do, so corrupt
+   persisted numeric text cannot silently enter the domain.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import re
+import sqlite3
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Final
+from uuid import uuid4
+
+from mike_trade.domain.accounts import AccountEnvironment
+from mike_trade.domain.errors import PersistenceError
+
+__all__ = [
+    "open_connection",
+    "discover_migrations",
+    "apply_migrations",
+    "current_schema_version",
+    "initialize_database",
+    "to_db_timestamp",
+    "from_db_timestamp",
+    "decimal_to_db",
+    "decimal_from_db",
+    "EXPECTED_TABLES",
+    "MigrationChecksumError",
+    "SchemaTooNewError",
+    "DatabaseIdentityMismatchError",
+]
+
+
+class MigrationChecksumError(PersistenceError):
+    """An applied migration no longer has its recorded contents."""
+
+
+class SchemaTooNewError(PersistenceError):
+    """The database was migrated by a newer version of the application."""
+
+
+class DatabaseIdentityMismatchError(PersistenceError):
+    """The database identity does not match the requested environment."""
+
+
+EXPECTED_TABLES: Final[frozenset[str]] = frozenset(
+    {
+        "schema_migrations",
+        "db_identity",
+        "account_scopes",
+        "run_configs",
+        "operator_commands",
+        "service_health",
+        "instruments",
+        "instrument_capabilities",
+        "market_bars",
+        "strategy_instances",
+        "strategy_evaluations",
+        "signals",
+        "decisions",
+        "position_cycles",
+        "budget_reservations",
+        "order_intents",
+        "broker_orders",
+        "broker_order_events",
+        "fills",
+        "broker_activities",
+        "protection_orders",
+        "trailing_stop_states",
+        "trailing_stop_events",
+        "positions",
+        "cash_events",
+        "equity_snapshots",
+        "reconciliation_runs",
+        "reconciliation_drifts",
+        "reconciliation_resolutions",
+        "strategy_state",
+        "entry_eligibility_counters",
+        "entry_lockouts",
+        "entry_cooldowns",
+        "entry_controls",
+        "backtest_manifests",
+        "domain_events",
+    }
+)
+
+_MIGRATION_RE = re.compile(r"^(?P<version>[0-9]{4})_(?P<name>[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\.sql$")
+_ENVIRONMENTS = frozenset(item.value for item in AccountEnvironment)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class _Migration:
+    version: int
+    name: str
+    path: Path
+    text: str
+    sha256: str
+
+
+def open_connection(path: str | Path, *, read_only: bool = False) -> sqlite3.Connection:
+    """Open a configured SQLite connection for an operational database."""
+    database_path = Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
+    if read_only:
+        uri = f"{database_path.as_uri()}?mode=ro"
+        conn = sqlite3.connect(uri, uri=True, isolation_level=None)
+        try:
+            conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
+            conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000")
+            conn.execute("PRAGMA query_only = ON")
+        except BaseException:
+            conn.close()
+            raise
+        return conn
+
+    conn = sqlite3.connect(database_path, isolation_level=None)
+    try:
+        conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
+        mode = str(conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL").fetchone()[0]).lower()
+        if mode != "wal":
+            raise PersistenceError(f"SQLite refused WAL mode for {database_path}: {mode!r}")
+        conn.execute("PRAGMA synchronous = FULL")
+        conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000")
+    except BaseException:
+        conn.close()
+        raise
+    return conn
+
+
+def discover_migrations(migrations_dir: str | Path | None = None) -> tuple[_Migration, ...]:
+    """Read a complete, consecutively numbered set of forward migrations."""
+    directory = (
+        Path(migrations_dir)
+        if migrations_dir is not None
+        else Path(__file__).parent / "migrations"
+    )
+    discovered: list[_Migration] = []
+    versions: set[int] = set()
+    paths = directory.iterdir() if directory.is_dir() else ()
+    for path in sorted(paths, key=lambda item: item.name):
+        match = _MIGRATION_RE.fullmatch(path.name)
+        if match is None or not path.is_file():
+            continue
+        version = int(match.group("version"))
+        if version in versions:
+            raise PersistenceError(f"duplicate migration version {version:04d} in {directory}")
+        versions.add(version)
+        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+        discovered.append(
+            _Migration(
+                version=version,
+                name=match.group("name"),
+                path=path,
+                text=text,
+                sha256=hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
+            )
+        )
+    discovered.sort(key=lambda migration: migration.version)
+    actual = [migration.version for migration in discovered]
+    expected = list(range(1, len(discovered) + 1))
+    if actual != expected:
+        raise PersistenceError(
+            f"migration versions must be consecutive starting at 0001; found {actual}"
+        )
+    return tuple(discovered)
+
+
+def _schema_migrations_exists(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> bool:
+    row = conn.execute(
+        "SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'schema_migrations'"
+    ).fetchone()
+    return row is not None
+
+
+def current_schema_version(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> int:
+    """Return the greatest applied migration version, or zero for a fresh DB."""
+    if not _schema_migrations_exists(conn):
+        return 0
+    row = conn.execute("SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) FROM schema_migrations").fetchone()
+    return int(row[0])
+
+
+def _migration_statements(text: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+    """Split SQL without losing trigger bodies; unlike executescript, do not commit."""
+    statements: list[str] = []
+    buffer = ""
+    for character in text:
+        buffer += character
+        if character == ";" and sqlite3.complete_statement(buffer):
+            if buffer.strip():
+                statements.append(buffer)
+            buffer = ""
+    remaining_lines = (line for line in buffer.splitlines() if line.strip())
+    if buffer.strip() and not all(line.lstrip().startswith("--") for line in remaining_lines):
+        if not sqlite3.complete_statement(buffer):
+            raise sqlite3.OperationalError("incomplete SQL at end of migration")
+        statements.append(buffer)
+    return tuple(statements)
+
+
+def apply_migrations(
+    conn: sqlite3.Connection,
+    migrations_dir: str | Path | None = None,
+    *,
+    now: datetime,
+) -> None:
+    """Verify applied migration contents and atomically apply each pending file."""
+    migrations = discover_migrations(migrations_dir)
+    current = current_schema_version(conn)
+    highest_known = migrations[-1].version if migrations else 0
+    if current > highest_known:
+        raise SchemaTooNewError(
+            f"database schema version {current} exceeds highest known version {highest_known}"
+        )
+
+    applied: dict[int, tuple[str, str]] = {}
+    if _schema_migrations_exists(conn):
+        rows = conn.execute("SELECT version, name, sha256 FROM schema_migrations").fetchall()
+        applied = {int(version): (str(name), str(checksum)) for version, name, checksum in rows}
+    known_by_version = {migration.version: migration for migration in migrations}
+    unknown_applied = sorted(set(applied) - set(known_by_version))
+    if unknown_applied:
+        raise SchemaTooNewError(f"database contains unknown migration versions: {unknown_applied}")
+    for version, (_, recorded_checksum) in applied.items():
+        migration = known_by_version[version]
+        if recorded_checksum != migration.sha256:
+            raise MigrationChecksumError(
+                f"migration {version:04d}_{migration.name}.sql checksum does not match database"
+            )
+
+    applied_at = to_db_timestamp(now)
+    for migration in migrations:
+        if migration.version in applied:
+            continue
+        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+        try:
+            for statement in _migration_statements(migration.text):
+                conn.execute(statement)
+            conn.execute(
+                "INSERT INTO schema_migrations(version, name, sha256, applied_at) "
+                "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
+                (migration.version, migration.name, migration.sha256, applied_at),
+            )
+            conn.execute("COMMIT")
+        except BaseException:
+            if conn.in_transaction:
+                conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
+            raise
+
+
+def _environment_value(environment: AccountEnvironment | str) -> str:
+    value = environment.value if isinstance(environment, AccountEnvironment) else environment
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or value not in _ENVIRONMENTS:
+        raise ValueError(f"environment must be one of {sorted(_ENVIRONMENTS)}")
+    return value
+
+
+def initialize_database(
+    path: str | Path,
+    environment: AccountEnvironment | str,
+    *,
+    now: datetime,
+) -> sqlite3.Connection:
+    """Open, migrate, and bind a database permanently to one environment."""
+    expected_environment = _environment_value(environment)
+    conn = open_connection(path)
+    try:
+        apply_migrations(conn, now=now)
+        created_at = to_db_timestamp(now)
+        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+        try:
+            identity = conn.execute(
+                "SELECT environment FROM db_identity WHERE id = 1"
+            ).fetchone()
+            if identity is None:
+                conn.execute(
+                    "INSERT INTO db_identity(id, environment, database_id, created_at) "
+                    "VALUES (1, ?, ?, ?)",
+                    (expected_environment, str(uuid4()), created_at),
+                )
+            elif identity[0] != expected_environment:
+                raise DatabaseIdentityMismatchError(
+                    f"database environment is {identity[0]!r}, not {expected_environment!r}"
+                )
+            conn.execute("COMMIT")
+        except BaseException:
+            if conn.in_transaction:
+                conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
+            raise
+    except BaseException:
+        conn.close()
+        raise
+    return conn
+
+
+def to_db_timestamp(value: datetime) -> str:
+    """Serialize an aware datetime as fixed-width microsecond UTC text."""
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError("database timestamps require a timezone-aware datetime")
+    return value.astimezone(UTC).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ")
+
+
+def from_db_timestamp(text: str) -> datetime:
+    """Parse the database's fixed-width UTC timestamp representation."""
+    if not isinstance(text, str):
+        raise TypeError("database timestamp must be str")
+    try:
+        value = datetime.strptime(text, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ").replace(tzinfo=UTC)
+    except ValueError as error:
+        raise ValueError(f"invalid database timestamp: {text!r}") from error
+    if to_db_timestamp(value) != text:
+        raise ValueError(f"invalid database timestamp: {text!r}")
+    return value
+
+
+def decimal_to_db(value: Decimal) -> str:
+    """Serialize a finite Decimal without accepting lossy float input."""
+    if not isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        raise TypeError("database decimal value must be Decimal")
+    if not value.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError("database decimal value must be finite")
+    return str(value)
+
+
+def decimal_from_db(text: str) -> Decimal:
+    """Parse finite decimal text from SQLite."""
+    if not isinstance(text, str):
+        raise TypeError("database decimal value must be str")
+    try:
+        value = Decimal(text)
+    except InvalidOperation as error:
+        raise ValueError(f"invalid database decimal: {text!r}") from error
+    if not value.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError("database decimal value must be finite")
+    return value

+

+"""SQLite connection, migration, and scalar-persistence helpers.
+
+Design choices (4, the task's decision budget):
+1. ``discover_migrations`` returns immutable private records containing the
+   version, unprefixed name, path, text, and text checksum.
+2. Migration names stored in ``schema_migrations`` omit the numeric prefix and
+   ``.sql`` suffix (for example, ``initial``).
+3. Database environments may be supplied as either ``AccountEnvironment``
+   values or their uppercase strings, keeping this infrastructure boundary
+   convenient without duplicating the domain enum.
+4. Decimal reads reject non-finite values just as decimal writes do, so corrupt
+   persisted numeric text cannot silently enter the domain.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import re
+import sqlite3
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Final
+from uuid import uuid4
+
+from mike_trade.domain.accounts import AccountEnvironment
+from mike_trade.domain.errors import PersistenceError
+
+__all__ = [
+    "open_connection",
+    "discover_migrations",
+    "apply_migrations",
+    "current_schema_version",
+    "initialize_database",
+    "to_db_timestamp",
+    "from_db_timestamp",
+    "decimal_to_db",
+    "decimal_from_db",
+    "EXPECTED_TABLES",
+    "MigrationChecksumError",
+    "SchemaTooNewError",
+    "DatabaseIdentityMismatchError",
+]
+
+
+class MigrationChecksumError(PersistenceError):
+    """An applied migration no longer has its recorded contents."""
+
+
+class SchemaTooNewError(PersistenceError):
+    """The database was migrated by a newer version of the application."""
+
+
+class DatabaseIdentityMismatchError(PersistenceError):
+    """The database identity does not match the requested environment."""
+
+
+EXPECTED_TABLES: Final[frozenset[str]] = frozenset(
+    {
+        "schema_migrations",
+        "db_identity",
+        "account_scopes",
+        "run_configs",
+        "operator_commands",
+        "service_health",
+        "instruments",
+        "instrument_capabilities",
+        "market_bars",
+        "strategy_instances",
+        "strategy_evaluations",
+        "signals",
+        "decisions",
+        "position_cycles",
+        "budget_reservations",
+        "order_intents",
+        "broker_orders",
+        "broker_order_events",
+        "fills",
+        "broker_activities",
+        "protection_orders",
+        "trailing_stop_states",
+        "trailing_stop_events",
+        "positions",
+        "cash_events",
+        "equity_snapshots",
+        "reconciliation_runs",
+        "reconciliation_drifts",
+        "reconciliation_resolutions",
+        "strategy_state",
+        "entry_eligibility_counters",
+        "entry_lockouts",
+        "entry_cooldowns",
+        "entry_controls",
+        "backtest_manifests",
+        "domain_events",
+    }
+)
+
+_MIGRATION_RE = re.compile(r"^(?P<version>[0-9]{4})_(?P<name>[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\.sql$")
+_ENVIRONMENTS = frozenset(item.value for item in AccountEnvironment)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class _Migration:
+    version: int
+    name: str
+    path: Path
+    text: str
+    sha256: str
+
+
+def open_connection(path: str | Path, *, read_only: bool = False) -> sqlite3.Connection:
+    """Open a configured SQLite connection for an operational database."""
+    database_path = Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
+    if read_only:
+        uri = f"{database_path.as_uri()}?mode=ro"
+        conn = sqlite3.connect(uri, uri=True, isolation_level=None)
+        try:
+            conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
+            conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000")
+            conn.execute("PRAGMA query_only = ON")
+        except BaseException:
+            conn.close()
+            raise
+        return conn
+
+    conn = sqlite3.connect(database_path, isolation_level=None)
+    try:
+        conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
+        mode = str(conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL").fetchone()[0]).lower()
+        if mode != "wal":
+            raise PersistenceError(f"SQLite refused WAL mode for {database_path}: {mode!r}")
+        conn.execute("PRAGMA synchronous = FULL")
+        conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000")
+    except BaseException:
+        conn.close()
+        raise
+    return conn
+
+
+def discover_migrations(migrations_dir: str | Path | None = None) -> tuple[_Migration, ...]:
+    """Read a complete, consecutively numbered set of forward migrations."""
+    directory = (
+        Path(migrations_dir)
+        if migrations_dir is not None
+        else Path(__file__).parent / "migrations"
+    )
+    discovered: list[_Migration] = []
+    versions: set[int] = set()
+    paths = directory.iterdir() if directory.is_dir() else ()
+    for path in sorted(paths, key=lambda item: item.name):
+        match = _MIGRATION_RE.fullmatch(path.name)
+        if match is None or not path.is_file():
+            continue
+        version = int(match.group("version"))
+        if version in versions:
+            raise PersistenceError(f"duplicate migration version {version:04d} in {directory}")
+        versions.add(version)
+        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+        discovered.append(
+            _Migration(
+                version=version,
+                name=match.group("name"),
+                path=path,
+                text=text,
+                sha256=hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
+            )
+        )
+    discovered.sort(key=lambda migration: migration.version)
+    actual = [migration.version for migration in discovered]
+    expected = list(range(1, len(discovered) + 1))
+    if actual != expected:
+        raise PersistenceError(
+            f"migration versions must be consecutive starting at 0001; found {actual}"
+        )
+    return tuple(discovered)
+
+
+def _schema_migrations_exists(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> bool:
+    row = conn.execute(
+        "SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'schema_migrations'"
+    ).fetchone()
+    return row is not None
+
+
+def current_schema_version(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> int:
+    """Return the greatest applied migration version, or zero for a fresh DB."""
+    if not _schema_migrations_exists(conn):
+        return 0
+    row = conn.execute("SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) FROM schema_migrations").fetchone()
+    return int(row[0])
+
+
+def _migration_statements(text: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+    """Split SQL without losing trigger bodies; unlike executescript, do not commit."""
+    statements: list[str] = []
+    buffer = ""
+    for character in text:
+        buffer += character
+        if character == ";" and sqlite3.complete_statement(buffer):
+            if buffer.strip():
+                statements.append(buffer)
+            buffer = ""
+    remaining_lines = (line for line in buffer.splitlines() if line.strip())
+    if buffer.strip() and not all(line.lstrip().startswith("--") for line in remaining_lines):
+        if not sqlite3.complete_statement(buffer):
+            raise sqlite3.OperationalError("incomplete SQL at end of migration")
+        statements.append(buffer)
+    return tuple(statements)
+
+
+def apply_migrations(
+    conn: sqlite3.Connection,
+    migrations_dir: str | Path | None = None,
+    *,
+    now: datetime,
+) -> None:
+    """Verify applied migration contents and atomically apply each pending file."""
+    migrations = discover_migrations(migrations_dir)
+    current = current_schema_version(conn)
+    highest_known = migrations[-1].version if migrations else 0
+    if current > highest_known:
+        raise SchemaTooNewError(
+            f"database schema version {current} exceeds highest known version {highest_known}"
+        )
+
+    applied: dict[int, tuple[str, str]] = {}
+    if _schema_migrations_exists(conn):
+        rows = conn.execute("SELECT version, name, sha256 FROM schema_migrations").fetchall()
+        applied = {int(version): (str(name), str(checksum)) for version, name, checksum in rows}
+    known_by_version = {migration.version: migration for migration in migrations}
+    unknown_applied = sorted(set(applied) - set(known_by_version))
+    if unknown_applied:
+        raise SchemaTooNewError(f"database contains unknown migration versions: {unknown_applied}")
+    for version, (_, recorded_checksum) in applied.items():
+        migration = known_by_version[version]
+        if recorded_checksum != migration.sha256:
+            raise MigrationChecksumError(
+                f"migration {version:04d}_{migration.name}.sql checksum does not match database"
+            )
+
+    applied_at = to_db_timestamp(now)
+    for migration in migrations:
+        if migration.version in applied:
+            continue
+        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+        try:
+            for statement in _migration_statements(migration.text):
+                conn.execute(statement)
+            conn.execute(
+                "INSERT INTO schema_migrations(version, name, sha256, applied_at) "
+                "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
+                (migration.version, migration.name, migration.sha256, applied_at),
+            )
+            conn.execute("COMMIT")
+        except BaseException:
+            if conn.in_transaction:
+                conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
+            raise
+
+
+def _environment_value(environment: AccountEnvironment | str) -> str:
+    value = environment.value if isinstance(environment, AccountEnvironment) else environment
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or value not in _ENVIRONMENTS:
+        raise ValueError(f"environment must be one of {sorted(_ENVIRONMENTS)}")
+    return value
+
+
+def initialize_database(
+    path: str | Path,
+    environment: AccountEnvironment | str,
+    *,
+    now: datetime,
+) -> sqlite3.Connection:
+    """Open, migrate, and bind a database permanently to one environment."""
+    expected_environment = _environment_value(environment)
+    conn = open_connection(path)
+    try:
+        apply_migrations(conn, now=now)
+        created_at = to_db_timestamp(now)
+        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+        try:
+            identity = conn.execute(
+                "SELECT environment FROM db_identity WHERE id = 1"
+            ).fetchone()
+            if identity is None:
+                conn.execute(
+                    "INSERT INTO db_identity(id, environment, database_id, created_at) "
+                    "VALUES (1, ?, ?, ?)",
+                    (expected_environment, str(uuid4()), created_at),
+                )
+            elif identity[0] != expected_environment:
+                raise DatabaseIdentityMismatchError(
+                    f"database environment is {identity[0]!r}, not {expected_environment!r}"
+                )
+            conn.execute("COMMIT")
+        except BaseException:
+            if conn.in_transaction:
+                conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
+            raise
+    except BaseException:
+        conn.close()
+        raise
+    return conn
+
+
+def to_db_timestamp(value: datetime) -> str:
+    """Serialize an aware datetime as fixed-width microsecond UTC text."""
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError("database timestamps require a timezone-aware datetime")
+    return value.astimezone(UTC).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ")
+
+
+def from_db_timestamp(text: str) -> datetime:
+    """Parse the database's fixed-width UTC timestamp representation."""
+    if not isinstance(text, str):
+        raise TypeError("database timestamp must be str")
+    try:
+        value = datetime.strptime(text, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ").replace(tzinfo=UTC)
+    except ValueError as error:
+        raise ValueError(f"invalid database timestamp: {text!r}") from error
+    if to_db_timestamp(value) != text:
+        raise ValueError(f"invalid database timestamp: {text!r}")
+    return value
+
+
+def decimal_to_db(value: Decimal) -> str:
+    """Serialize a finite Decimal without accepting lossy float input."""
+    if not isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        raise TypeError("database decimal value must be Decimal")
+    if not value.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError("database decimal value must be finite")
+    return str(value)
+
+
+def decimal_from_db(text: str) -> Decimal:
+    """Parse finite decimal text from SQLite."""
+    if not isinstance(text, str):
+        raise TypeError("database decimal value must be str")
+    try:
+        value = Decimal(text)
+    except InvalidOperation as error:
+        raise ValueError(f"invalid database decimal: {text!r}") from error
+    if not value.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError("database decimal value must be finite")
+    return value

+"""SQLite connection, migration, and scalar-persistence helpers.
+
+Design choices (4, the task's decision budget):
+1. ``discover_migrations`` returns immutable private records containing the
+   version, unprefixed name, path, text, and text checksum.
+2. Migration names stored in ``schema_migrations`` omit the numeric prefix and
+   ``.sql`` suffix (for example, ``initial``).
+3. Database environments may be supplied as either ``AccountEnvironment``
+   values or their uppercase strings, keeping this infrastructure boundary
+   convenient without duplicating the domain enum.
+4. Decimal reads reject non-finite values just as decimal writes do, so corrupt
+   persisted numeric text cannot silently enter the domain.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import re
+import sqlite3
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Final
+from uuid import uuid4
+
+from mike_trade.domain.accounts import AccountEnvironment
+from mike_trade.domain.errors import PersistenceError
+
+__all__ = [
+    "open_connection",
+    "discover_migrations",
+    "apply_migrations",
+    "current_schema_version",
+    "initialize_database",
+    "to_db_timestamp",
+    "from_db_timestamp",
+    "decimal_to_db",
+    "decimal_from_db",
+    "EXPECTED_TABLES",
+    "MigrationChecksumError",
+    "SchemaTooNewError",
+    "DatabaseIdentityMismatchError",
+]
+
+
+class MigrationChecksumError(PersistenceError):
+    """An applied migration no longer has its recorded contents."""
+
+
+class SchemaTooNewError(PersistenceError):
+    """The database was migrated by a newer version of the application."""
+
+
+class DatabaseIdentityMismatchError(PersistenceError):
+    """The database identity does not match the requested environment."""
+
+
+EXPECTED_TABLES: Final[frozenset[str]] = frozenset(
+    {
+        "schema_migrations",
+        "db_identity",
+        "account_scopes",
+        "run_configs",
+        "operator_commands",
+        "service_health",
+        "instruments",
+        "instrument_capabilities",
+        "market_bars",
+        "strategy_instances",
+        "strategy_evaluations",
+        "signals",
+        "decisions",
+        "position_cycles",
+        "budget_reservations",
+        "order_intents",
+        "broker_orders",
+        "broker_order_events",
+        "fills",
+        "broker_activities",
+        "protection_orders",
+        "trailing_stop_states",
+        "trailing_stop_events",
+        "positions",
+        "cash_events",
+        "equity_snapshots",
+        "reconciliation_runs",
+        "reconciliation_drifts",
+        "reconciliation_resolutions",
+        "strategy_state",
+        "entry_eligibility_counters",
+        "entry_lockouts",
+        "entry_cooldowns",
+        "entry_controls",
+        "backtest_manifests",
+        "domain_events",
+    }
+)
+
+_MIGRATION_RE = re.compile(r"^(?P<version>[0-9]{4})_(?P<name>[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\.sql$")
+_ENVIRONMENTS = frozenset(item.value for item in AccountEnvironment)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class _Migration:
+    version: int
+    name: str
+    path: Path
+    text: str
+    sha256: str
+
+
+def open_connection(path: str | Path, *, read_only: bool = False) -> sqlite3.Connection:
+    """Open a configured SQLite connection for an operational database."""
+    database_path = Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
+    if read_only:
+        uri = f"{database_path.as_uri()}?mode=ro"
+        conn = sqlite3.connect(uri, uri=True, isolation_level=None)
+        try:
+            conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
+            conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000")
+            conn.execute("PRAGMA query_only = ON")
+        except BaseException:
+            conn.close()
+            raise
+        return conn
+
+    conn = sqlite3.connect(database_path, isolation_level=None)
+    try:
+        conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
+        mode = str(conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL").fetchone()[0]).lower()
+        if mode != "wal":
+            raise PersistenceError(f"SQLite refused WAL mode for {database_path}: {mode!r}")
+        conn.execute("PRAGMA synchronous = FULL")
+        conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000")
+    except BaseException:
+        conn.close()
+        raise
+    return conn
+
+
+def discover_migrations(migrations_dir: str | Path | None = None) -> tuple[_Migration, ...]:
+    """Read a complete, consecutively numbered set of forward migrations."""
+    directory = (
+        Path(migrations_dir)
+        if migrations_dir is not None
+        else Path(__file__).parent / "migrations"
+    )
+    discovered: list[_Migration] = []
+    versions: set[int] = set()
+    paths = directory.iterdir() if directory.is_dir() else ()
+    for path in sorted(paths, key=lambda item: item.name):
+        match = _MIGRATION_RE.fullmatch(path.name)
+        if match is None or not path.is_file():
+            continue
+        version = int(match.group("version"))
+        if version in versions:
+            raise PersistenceError(f"duplicate migration version {version:04d} in {directory}")
+        versions.add(version)
+        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+        discovered.append(
+            _Migration(
+                version=version,
+                name=match.group("name"),
+                path=path,
+                text=text,
+                sha256=hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
+            )
+        )
+    discovered.sort(key=lambda migration: migration.version)
+    actual = [migration.version for migration in discovered]
+    expected = list(range(1, len(discovered) + 1))
+    if actual != expected:
+        raise PersistenceError(
+            f"migration versions must be consecutive starting at 0001; found {actual}"
+        )
+    return tuple(discovered)
+
+
+def _schema_migrations_exists(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> bool:
+    row = conn.execute(
+        "SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'schema_migrations'"
+    ).fetchone()
+    return row is not None
+
+
+def current_schema_version(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> int:
+    """Return the greatest applied migration version, or zero for a fresh DB."""
+    if not _schema_migrations_exists(conn):
+        return 0
+    row = conn.execute("SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) FROM schema_migrations").fetchone()
+    return int(row[0])
+
+
+def _migration_statements(text: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+    """Split SQL without losing trigger bodies; unlike executescript, do not commit."""
+    statements: list[str] = []
+    buffer = ""
+    for character in text:
+        buffer += character
+        if character == ";" and sqlite3.complete_statement(buffer):
+            if buffer.strip():
+                statements.append(buffer)
+            buffer = ""
+    remaining_lines = (line for line in buffer.splitlines() if line.strip())
+    if buffer.strip() and not all(line.lstrip().startswith("--") for line in remaining_lines):
+        if not sqlite3.complete_statement(buffer):
+            raise sqlite3.OperationalError("incomplete SQL at end of migration")
+        statements.append(buffer)
+    return tuple(statements)
+
+
+def apply_migrations(
+    conn: sqlite3.Connection,
+    migrations_dir: str | Path | None = None,
+    *,
+    now: datetime,
+) -> None:
+    """Verify applied migration contents and atomically apply each pending file."""
+    migrations = discover_migrations(migrations_dir)
+    current = current_schema_version(conn)
+    highest_known = migrations[-1].version if migrations else 0
+    if current > highest_known:
+        raise SchemaTooNewError(
+            f"database schema version {current} exceeds highest known version {highest_known}"
+        )
+
+    applied: dict[int, tuple[str, str]] = {}
+    if _schema_migrations_exists(conn):
+        rows = conn.execute("SELECT version, name, sha256 FROM schema_migrations").fetchall()
+        applied = {int(version): (str(name), str(checksum)) for version, name, checksum in rows}
+    known_by_version = {migration.version: migration for migration in migrations}
+    unknown_applied = sorted(set(applied) - set(known_by_version))
+    if unknown_applied:
+        raise SchemaTooNewError(f"database contains unknown migration versions: {unknown_applied}")
+    for version, (_, recorded_checksum) in applied.items():
+        migration = known_by_version[version]
+        if recorded_checksum != migration.sha256:
+            raise MigrationChecksumError(
+                f"migration {version:04d}_{migration.name}.sql checksum does not match database"
+            )
+
+    applied_at = to_db_timestamp(now)
+    for migration in migrations:
+        if migration.version in applied:
+            continue
+        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+        try:
+            for statement in _migration_statements(migration.text):
+                conn.execute(statement)
+            conn.execute(
+                "INSERT INTO schema_migrations(version, name, sha256, applied_at) "
+                "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
+                (migration.version, migration.name, migration.sha256, applied_at),
+            )
+            conn.execute("COMMIT")
+        except BaseException:
+            if conn.in_transaction:
+                conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
+            raise
+
+
+def _environment_value(environment: AccountEnvironment | str) -> str:
+    value = environment.value if isinstance(environment, AccountEnvironment) else environment
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or value not in _ENVIRONMENTS:
+        raise ValueError(f"environment must be one of {sorted(_ENVIRONMENTS)}")
+    return value
+
+
+def initialize_database(
+    path: str | Path,
+    environment: AccountEnvironment | str,
+    *,
+    now: datetime,
+) -> sqlite3.Connection:
+    """Open, migrate, and bind a database permanently to one environment."""
+    expected_environment = _environment_value(environment)
+    conn = open_connection(path)
+    try:
+        apply_migrations(conn, now=now)
+        created_at = to_db_timestamp(now)
+        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+        try:
+            identity = conn.execute(
+                "SELECT environment FROM db_identity WHERE id = 1"
+            ).fetchone()
+            if identity is None:
+                conn.execute(
+                    "INSERT INTO db_identity(id, environment, database_id, created_at) "
+                    "VALUES (1, ?, ?, ?)",
+                    (expected_environment, str(uuid4()), created_at),
+                )
+            elif identity[0] != expected_environment:
+                raise DatabaseIdentityMismatchError(
+                    f"database environment is {identity[0]!r}, not {expected_environment!r}"
+                )
+            conn.execute("COMMIT")
+        except BaseException:
+            if conn.in_transaction:
+                conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
+            raise
+    except BaseException:
+        conn.close()
+        raise
+    return conn
+
+
+def to_db_timestamp(value: datetime) -> str:
+    """Serialize an aware datetime as fixed-width microsecond UTC text."""
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError("database timestamps require a timezone-aware datetime")
+    return value.astimezone(UTC).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ")
+
+
+def from_db_timestamp(text: str) -> datetime:
+    """Parse the database's fixed-width UTC timestamp representation."""
+    if not isinstance(text, str):
+        raise TypeError("database timestamp must be str")
+    try:
+        value = datetime.strptime(text, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ").replace(tzinfo=UTC)
+    except ValueError as error:
+        raise ValueError(f"invalid database timestamp: {text!r}") from error
+    if to_db_timestamp(value) != text:
+        raise ValueError(f"invalid database timestamp: {text!r}")
+    return value
+
+
+def decimal_to_db(value: Decimal) -> str:
+    """Serialize a finite Decimal without accepting lossy float input."""
+    if not isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        raise TypeError("database decimal value must be Decimal")
+    if not value.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError("database decimal value must be finite")
+    return str(value)
+
+
+def decimal_from_db(text: str) -> Decimal:
+    """Parse finite decimal text from SQLite."""
+    if not isinstance(text, str):
+        raise TypeError("database decimal value must be str")
+    try:
+        value = Decimal(text)
+    except InvalidOperation as error:
+        raise ValueError(f"invalid database decimal: {text!r}") from error
+    if not value.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError("database decimal value must be finite")
+    return value

"""
Domain exceptions hierarchy for mike_trade.
"""

from collections.abc import Mapping
from typing import Any


class MikeTradeError(Exception):
    """Base exception for all domain and runtime errors in mike_trade."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        message: str,
        *,
        code: str | None = None,
        context: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(message)
        self.message = message
        self.code = code
        self.context = context if context is not None else {}


class ConfigurationError(MikeTradeError):
    """Raised when application configuration is missing, invalid, or inconsistent."""


class LiveTradingNotAuthorizedError(MikeTradeError):
    """Raised when an action requires live trading authorization that is not explicitly enabled."""


class ModeIsolationError(MikeTradeError):
    """Raised when state, credentials, or operations cross isolated execution modes."""


class StaleMarketDataError(MikeTradeError):
    """Raised when market data is stale or beyond maximum acceptable age."""


class ReconciliationDriftError(MikeTradeError):
    """Raised when internal state drifts from broker authoritative state."""


class InsufficientBuyingPowerError(MikeTradeError):
    """Raised when account buying power is insufficient for a trade intent."""


class EntryBlockedError(MikeTradeError):
    """Raised when entry filters, limits, cooldowns, or lockouts block a new position."""


class UnsupportedOrderCapabilityError(MikeTradeError):
    """Raised when a requested order type or combination is unsupported by the broker/mode."""


class BrokerError(MikeTradeError):
    """Base exception for broker interaction failures."""


class BrokerRejectedError(BrokerError):
    """Raised when a broker explicitly rejects an order or request."""


class BrokerUnavailableError(BrokerError):
    """Raised when a broker endpoint is unreachable or unavailable."""


class PersistenceError(MikeTradeError):
    """Raised when database operations, migrations, or journal persistence fail."""


class StrategyError(MikeTradeError):
    """Raised when strategy evaluation or execution logic fails."""
"""Broker-neutral account, capability, health, and operator-control snapshots.

values are finite :class:`~decimal.Decimal` instances; and unsafe account flags

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from decimal import Decimal
from enum import Enum
from types import MappingProxyType
from typing import Mapping


def _require_utc(value: datetime, name: str) -> None:
    """Require an aware datetime whose UTC offset is zero."""
    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a UTC-aware datetime")
    if value.utcoffset() != timedelta(0):
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must use UTC (zero offset)")


def _require_decimal(value: Decimal | None, name: str) -> None:
    if value is None:
        return
    if not isinstance(value, Decimal):
        raise TypeError(f"{name} must be Decimal")
    if not value.is_finite():
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be finite")


def _require_nonempty(value: str, name: str) -> None:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a non-empty string")


class AccountEnvironment(Enum):
    BACKTEST = "BACKTEST"
    SHADOW = "SHADOW"
    PAPER = "PAPER"
    LIVE = "LIVE"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class AccountScope:
    """Identity boundary for account-wide cash, buying power, and positions."""

    environment: AccountEnvironment
    account_id: str
    scenario: str | None = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if not isinstance(self.environment, AccountEnvironment):
            raise TypeError("environment must be an AccountEnvironment")
        _require_nonempty(self.account_id, "account_id")
        if self.environment in (AccountEnvironment.SHADOW, AccountEnvironment.BACKTEST):
            _require_nonempty(self.scenario, "scenario")
        elif self.scenario is not None:
            raise ValueError("scenario is only valid for SHADOW and BACKTEST scopes")

    @property
    def scope_id(self) -> str:
        """Stable, environment-qualified scope key."""
        prefix = self.environment.value.lower()
        if self.scenario is None:
            return f"{prefix}:{self.account_id}"
        return f"{prefix}:{self.account_id}:{self.scenario}"

        _require_nonempty(self.provider, "provider")
        if not isinstance(self.environment, AccountEnvironment):
            raise TypeError("environment must be an AccountEnvironment")
        if not isinstance(self.supported_order_types, frozenset):
            raise TypeError("supported_order_types must be a frozenset")
        if not isinstance(self.paper_verified_combinations, frozenset):
            raise TypeError("paper_verified_combinations must be a frozenset")

    def supports_order(self, order_type: str, fractional: bool) -> bool:
        """Return true only for an explicitly advertised, verified combination."""
        if order_type not in self.supported_order_types:

        return True

def _validate_order_prices(
    order_type: OrderType,
    limit_price: Decimal | None,
    stop_price: Decimal | None,
    trail_price: Decimal | None,
    trail_percent: Decimal | None,
) -> None:
    if order_type in {OrderType.LIMIT, OrderType.STOP_LIMIT}:
        if limit_price is None:
            raise ValueError(f"{order_type.value} orders require limit_price")
    elif limit_price is not None:
        raise ValueError(f"{order_type.value} orders must not specify limit_price")

    if order_type in {OrderType.STOP, OrderType.STOP_LIMIT}:
        if stop_price is None:
            raise ValueError(f"{order_type.value} orders require stop_price")
    elif stop_price is not None:
        raise ValueError(f"{order_type.value} orders must not specify stop_price")

    trail_count = int(trail_price is not None) + int(trail_percent is not None)
    if order_type is OrderType.TRAILING_STOP:
        if trail_count != 1:
            raise ValueError("TRAILING_STOP orders require exactly one trail value")
    elif trail_count:
        raise ValueError(f"{order_type.value} orders must not specify a trail value")

    def ratchet(self, new_stop_price: Decimal, observed_high: Decimal) -> TrailingStopState:
        new_stop = _require_decimal(
            new_stop_price, field="new_stop_price", minimum=_ZERO, inclusive=False
        )
        new_high = _require_decimal(
            observed_high, field="observed_high", minimum=_ZERO, inclusive=False
        )
        if new_stop < self.stop_price:
            raise ValueError("a long protective stop must never move downward")
        if new_high < self.high_water_mark:
            raise ValueError("a long high_water_mark must never move downward")
        if new_stop > new_high:
            raise ValueError("new_stop_price must not exceed observed_high")
        return replace(self, stop_price=new_stop, high_water_mark=new_high)

    def with_covered_quantity(self, remaining: Decimal) -> TrailingStopState:
        quantity = _require_decimal(
            remaining, field="remaining", minimum=_ZERO, inclusive=False
        )
        if quantity > self.covered_quantity:
            raise ValueError("covered quantity must not exceed confirmed remaining quantity")
        return replace(self, covered_quantity=quantity)
